design-system.summary:
I turned "Sehari Semalam" into a design system that builds and passes its checks. Everything is in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mm-logink/a373dafe-cad0-44b3-be23-c6da0cb9f694/scratchpad/blueprint/design-system/. tokens.css is the only stylesheet of the v2 site and doubles as the Tailwind entry through `@config`. tailwind.tokens.ts holds the Tailwind 3.4 theme plus JS copies of the motion values and a helper that maps each hour to its stage. tailwind.v2.config.ts, fonts.ts (next/font setup) and check.mjs complete the set.

I compiled it with the repo's own Tailwind 3.4.19 and type-checked all three TS files with the repo's tsc. Minified with every component class, the CSS is 26,293 B (6,643 B gzip). Today's inlined CSS is 82 KB.

The hour system is plain CSS. `data-hour="HHMM"` sets the key light by time of day (04–09 magenta, 10–16 crimson, 17–19 coral, 20–03 orange) and a default ground. `data-ground` switches the surface and all ink roles. `data-stage` sets the key light only. Small key-colored text is declared only where it passes AA on that ground; every other pair is set to `initial` and falls back to the ground's normal ink, so the allow-list in the CSS is the contrast matrix.

check.mjs verifies:
- 54 allowed pairs pass.
- 17 banned pairs are confirmed below their threshold (2 more are banned by the house rule).
- The CSS allow-list names only allowed pairs.
- All 24 hours give the same stage in CSS and TS.
- In Chromium, 77 hour × ground combinations pass on computed styles.
- Every measured fallback font is within ±2.2% of Archivo's width.

A mutation test (inject a banned pair, shift one hour's stage) makes it fail.

I fixed five problems in the direction:
- **H1 maximum size:** 140/52 = 2.69× breaks the WCAG zoom rule (1.4.4). The title now tops out at 130 px.
- **Fallback font:** the one-face fallback chain can't be tuned. I replaced it with separate measured fallbacks for each type style.
- **AI mock label:** coral 12 px text on Senja Dalam is 4.06:1, below AA. It now uses the secondary text colour.
- **Header logo:** a server-rendered header can't change the logo's `theme` prop as the sky changes. One logo instance plus a CSS fill override gives identical pixels.
- **Datelines at 15–16h:** they now say 'Sore' instead of 'Siang'.

Implementation traps I verified:
- A bare `:has()` in a selector list drops the whole rule on Firefox 111–120, which the repo still supports.
- Tailwind ignores backslash-escaped parentheses in content globs; `[(]…[)]` works.
- LogoFull's default theme is 'dark', which paints a white "Log" on paper.
- Defining `--font-sans` really does change the wordmark in Chromium.

The component inventory lists 99 components, 18 of them sections, each marked server or client with where it's used. The rules cover motifs, gradients, honesty captions, logo placement, dark share and Mode teks. The admin stays untouched through separate root layouts, and the section list ends with an outline for DESIGN.md v2.

components.name: Section
components.notes: src/components/ds/Section.tsx. Renders <section data-hour data-ground? aria-labelledby>. Prop hour (required), ground (defaults from hourInfo), pad sm|md|none. Grounds paint their own surface, so don't add bg-* utilities.

components.name: Wrap
components.notes: .wrap (1360 + gutters); grid prop adds .grid-12. Tailwind container plugin disabled.

components.name: Dateline
components.notes: Motif 1. 'JAKARTA, 12.40 WIB — SIANG · DIPERCAYA' + right label, built from hourInfo(hour, locale). Plain text, no <time> (a narrative clock is not a real date). Colour comes from --key-ink.

components.name: DisplayLines
components.used_on: home H1, 4 chapter titles, service H1s
components.notes: lines[] → span.ln (nowrap). Literal ' ' text nodes between spans so h1.textContent === approved string (CI). Optional kicker, wideIndex (Kata Lebar, max 1) and tail. Front-page rise class only on H1, maskless, opacity stays 1.

components.name: ClockNumeral
components.notes: .t-clock, aria-hidden (the dateline already says the hour). Part of the chapter-opener anatomy, not a motif.

components.name: Stabilo
components.used_on: entity sentence (home/about/footer), every 'Jawaban singkat', AI-page margin note
components.notes: Motif 3. <mark class='stabilo'>, paper grounds only. Becomes an underline in forced-colors.

components.name: DayDial
components.used_on: layout (progress), home hero (strip), service 'Posisi di loop' (loop)
components.notes: Motif 2. Variants: progress (fixed 3px, aria-hidden, sun tick on scroll(root), static in Firefox), strip (4 real <a> labelled by stage + services), loop (this service's segment lit). Hard segments, never a gradient.

components.name: Chip
components.used_on: mega menu, services table 'Tahap', stat sources, AI engine chips, blog categories, profiler choices
components.notes: The only pills. Variants: stage (data-stage dot, decorative), source (outbound link + year), engine (plain text, no logos), filter (aria-current), choice (48px button).

components.name: Button
components.notes: Variants ink|ghost|text; sizes sm|md|lg. href renders <a>. Replaces components/ui/Button.tsx behind the same prop API (ContactForm, CtaRenderer). No gradient, no crimson button, and never crimson next to WhatsApp.

components.name: WaButton
components.used_on: header pill, WaPill, bottom bar, closing band, service heroes, profiler, contact
components.notes: <a href={waLink(prefill)}> to wa.me, kept as <a> so GTM triggers still fire. #25D366 fill, #0A2E17 label + glyph, 1.5px inset edge on paper (--wa-edge), data-cursor='wa'. Label 'Chat WhatsApp'.

components.name: TextLink
components.notes: .link: always underlined (magenta vs Aspal is 2.8:1, WCAG 1.4.1). Descriptive anchors only; lint bans 'Selengkapnya' / 'Learn more'. arrow prop uses Icon.

components.name: Icon
components.notes: Inline SVG set: arrow-right (Archivo latin lacks U+2192), arrow-up-right, whatsapp, plus, minus, check, alert, play. aria-hidden, currentColor.

components.name: Caption
components.notes: <figcaption class='t-caption'>. Built from the asset-manifest entry (AI → 'Foto: ilustrasi AI · {tempat}, {HH.MM} WIB · bukan klien Logink'). An AI asset without a caption fails CI.

components.name: Media
components.used_on: heroes, chapter photos, case covers, blog
components.notes: next/image wrapper: sizes + alt required, priority only on the hero poster, radius 4, wipe prop (horizon wipe on the decorative layer only). Requires an asset key for the caption.

components.name: FilmLoop
components.notes: From cinematic-tech/FilmLoop.tsx. SSR poster via Media. src set after window load, only in view. Never under Save-Data, reduced motion or Mode teks. Pauses offscreen and on visibilitychange. aria-hidden, preload='none'. No video on phones.

components.name: DataTable
components.used_on: services table, pricing, comparisons, SEO/AEO/GEO, engine table
components.notes: <table class='tbl'> with caption. scroll prop: .tbl-scroll with sticky first column. stack prop reflows to blocks under 640 with explicit table/row/cell roles. 0 radius, hairlines, tabular-nums.

components.name: Faq
components.notes: <details> in .faq with 48px summary. Answers always in SSR HTML (fixes today's missing answers). interpolate-size / ::details-content where supported, instant otherwise. The same data source feeds the optional FAQPage JSON-LD.

components.name: FactList
components.used_on: service 'Ringkasan fakta', about entity facts, case snapshot
components.notes: <dl>; every value comes from the one facts source.

components.name: AnswerBlock
components.notes: 40–60 words, answer-first, under Stabilo, then 'Diperbarui {updatedAt} · Ditinjau oleh {nama, jabatan}' (the reviewer is required before the pilot). Sits on paper: dark pages use a Kertas inset.

components.name: SourcedStat
components.used_on: facts strip, Bab III (5 stats), service 'Bukti & data'
components.notes: Final value in the HTML (.t-stat, tabular), a sentence, then a source chip with year and outbound link. No count-up (cut). CI regex fails on '0 %', '0 +', '0.0 ×'.

components.name: Price
components.notes: Formats 'Mulai Rp …' from the facts source; the 'ditagih tahunan' flag is always rendered where true. Never hardcoded.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Only two badges. .badge-populer is crimson with a white label (4.95); 'contoh' is an outline chip.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.used_on: all inner pages incl. hubs and cases
components.notes: <nav> + BreadcrumbList into the page @graph.

components.name: Toc
components.notes: Sticky rail. TocSpy sets aria-current via IntersectionObserver. Anchors honour scroll-padding-top.

components.name: Field
components.notes: Input, Textarea, Select, CheckboxGroup: 48px, radius 4, 1px --line, --error text + alert icon via aria-describedby. Forms sit on Putih only.

components.name: Toggle
components.used_on: footer #mode-teks input (+ <label for> in Bab III / AI page), 'Tampilkan anotasi'
components.notes: Checkbox driven by CSS :has(). SiteObserver saves the Mode teks choice to localStorage; a pre-paint script restores it.

components.name: MockFrame
components.notes: <figure data-nosnippet> with .mock-label 'Ilustrasi · data contoh' in ink-2 (never coral). Sits on a senja-dalam / malam-dalam / putih ground. No dates, no 'Live', no third-party logos or chrome.

components.name: JsonLd
components.notes: One @graph per page. CI asserts every string of 20+ characters is visible text.

components.name: SkipLink
components.notes: z-skip; first focusable element.

components.name: LanguageSwitcher
components.notes: href from the server pair map (src/lib/services.ts registry), not usePathname. Fixes /index, /en/index and the local-seo 404. Head hreflang comes from the same map.

components.name: SiteHeader
components.notes: Pill; exactly one <LogoFull theme='light' className='logo-auto' />. The sky swap is CSS on html[data-sky], with a main[data-sky] fallback before hydration. Condense/hide via html[data-nav] + drawer ease. Triggers use popovertarget. 56px on phones, no announcement bar.

components.name: MegaMenu
components.notes: popover='auto', always in the SSR DOM; @starting-style + --ease-drawer. Live goal groups: Tingkatkan Organik / Tingkatkan Penjualan / Kreasi & Konten, each item with a stage Chip. Takes framer-motion out of Navbar.

components.name: MobileMenu
components.notes: <dialog> placed AFTER the header in the DOM (the Logo gradient ids are fixed). showModal() via the leaf, or commandfor/command where supported. No LogoFull inside it.

components.name: WaPill
components.notes: Fixed; never hides with the header. Magnetic on rich pointers. Replaces WhatsAppButton's pulse-glow FAB.

components.name: BottomBar
components.notes: 56px + safe-area inset: WhatsApp 60% / Penawaran 40% (btn-ink). On /contact it shows WhatsApp only. Hides while any field has focus via html:has(:is(input,textarea,select):focus). Follows html[data-sky].

components.name: SiteFooter
components.notes:
Kertas, WaButton above a giant LogoFull theme='light' (width 100%, height auto). Entity sentence verbatim, NAP, 6 services + AI page by name, column titles as

, privacy/terms, the #mode-teks input and the disclosure line.

components.name: ClosingBand
components.notes: data-hour='2130' (Malam): '21.30 — Satu pesan cukup.', WaButton with a per-page prefill, Minta Penawaran (btn-ink = Cahaya on dark, never crimson), and 'Nomor WhatsApp resmi Logink hanya +62 813-9453-933.'

components.name: HouseLights
components.notes: .house-lights > .hl-night (sticky ClosingBand) + .hl-sheet (Kertas: process/FAQ/footer) with the Semburat spill. The band needs ≥48px text-free bottom padding.

components.name: SiteObserver
components.notes: One IntersectionObserver + one passive rAF scroll listener. Writes data-in, data-step, html[data-sky] (from the computed --sky of the section under the header) and html[data-nav]. Persists Mode teks. Replaces the 73 framer whileInView files. Grows the 0.9 KB RevealObserver.

components.name: MotionRoot
components.notes: Imports SmoothScroll, Cursor and Lamp only when MEDIA.rich matches and Mode teks is off, so phones download 0 KB.

components.name: PageTransition
components.notes: 'Time-travel' cuts: 150ms out / 240ms in with a 12px rise, background crossfades to the destination's light; case card → case hero morph names. Instant under reduced motion.

components.name: SmoothScroll
components.notes: Lenis with LENIS config (lerp .1, autoRaf false on the motion frame loop, anchors, stopInertiaOnNavigate). data-lenis-prevent on the Maps iframe and scroll tables. Needs html scroll-behavior:smooth removed (done in tokens).

components.name: Cursor
components.notes: From motion-tech sz/src/Cursor.tsx. The dot reads --cursor-dot, the 96px disc --cursor-disc; green WhatsApp disc over [data-cursor='wa']. Hides the native cursor only in labelled zones. Off on forms, iframes, [data-cursor='hide'] and in Mode teks. Keyboard gets the :focus-visible::after label.

components.name: Lamp
components.notes: Pre-blurred pool moved by transform only, spring trail, mix-blend screen under text. Colour var(--lamp): off on paper.

components.name: Magnetic
components.notes: Max 14px, strength .35, spring 220/16/.4. Transform goes on a wrapper; .btn:active scale .97 stays on the button.

components.name: HoverReveal
components.notes: 4:5 hour-lit still ≤50 KB trails the pointer with ±10° velocity rotation. Touch and keyboard get SSR inline 96×72 thumbnails.

components.name: ProofLoupe
components.notes: 200px mask moved by transform with the annotation layer counter-translated (compositor only). Toggle 'anotasi' is the touch/keyboard path.

components.name: ScrollSequence
components.notes: cinematic-tech/ScrollSequence.tsx with the direction's fixes: runway h-runway = calc(4 × --stage-h), stage min-h-stage, 'mobile' tier deleted, gate MEDIA.canvas. Canvas is aria-hidden over the SSR poster .

components.name: StackScale
components.notes: Back cards scale .96/.92 via useTransform. CSS sticky does everything on phones.

components.name: SplitText
components.notes: Server-split word spans with aria-label on the heading and aria-hidden spans. 90ms per line / 45ms per word, capped at 600ms. Never on the H1, text never at opacity 0.

components.name: Ticker
components.notes: One of at most two infinite animations on screen; pauses on hover and under reduced motion; three static lines on phones.

components.notes: Marked 'contoh'; never a real-looking testimonial; no stars schema.

sections.title: 1 · Files delivered and loading contract
sections.body_markdown:
All files are in `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mm-logink/a373dafe-cad0-44b3-be23-c6da0cb9f694/scratchpad/blueprint/design-system/`.

| File | Repo destination | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `tokens.css` | `src/styles/tokens.css` | The ONE v2 stylesheet and the Tailwind entry (`@config "../../tailwind.v2.config.ts"`). Contents: primitives, 13 measured fallback `@font-face`, hour/stage/ground rules, base, component classes (type cuts, dateline, day dial, Stabilo, buttons, chips, tables, FAQ, horizon, house lights, logo override), user modes. |
| `tailwind.tokens.ts` | `src/styles/tailwind.tokens.ts` | Tailwind 3.4 `theme` (replaced + extended keys) + JS mirrors: `EASE`, `DUR`, `STAGGER`, `SPRING`, `MAGNETIC`, `LENIS`, `MEDIA`, `hourInfo()`, `skyOf()`, `stageLabel()`. Pure data. |
| `tailwind.v2.config.ts` | repo root | Content globs for v2 only (see traps), `theme`, `corePlugins.container: false`. |
| `fonts.ts` | `src/styles/fonts.ts` | next/font calls + the root-layout snippet (type-checked against repo `next`). |
| `check.mjs` | `scripts/check-tokens.mjs` | CI: AA matrix, CSS allow-list lint, hour parity, computed-style browser check, fallback widths. |
| `measure.cjs`, `logo-font.cjs` | none (evidence) | Fallback measurement; proof that `--font-sans` changes the wordmark. |
| `hour-grid.html/.jpg`, `hour-grid.cjs` | none (review) | Specimen of the hour system rendered from compiled CSS. |
| `compiled-sample.min.css` | none | Tailwind 3.4.19 output with every component class: **26,293 B raw / 6,643 B gzip** (today: 82 KB inlined per page, so `inlineCss: true` stays fine). |

**Loading contract (so v2 CSS never leaks into legacy or admin).**

```
src/app/(frontend)/(legacy)/layout.tsx  current root, moved: globals.css, Outfit/Bricolage, SetLang, lang="id"
src/app/(frontend)/(v2-id)/layout.tsx   <html lang="id">: tokens.css + fonts.ts + pre-paint script
src/app/(frontend)/(v2-en)/layout.tsx   <html lang="en">: same, lang="en"   (en/… folders live inside)
src/app/(payload)/admin/layout.tsx      untouched (Payload RootLayout + @payloadcms/next/css only)
```

Why three root layouts:
- Navigating across root layouts is a full page load (Next docs).
- The App Router keeps previously loaded stylesheets on client navigation. With a shared root, legacy `h1..h6 { font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -.03em }`, the cream `body` and `scroll-behavior: smooth` would bleed into v2 pages.
- Fonts also preload per root, so v2 pages never preload Outfit.
- The v2 roots give a correct SSR `<html lang>` immediately.
- A page switches design by moving its folder from `(legacy)` to `(v2-id)` / `(v2-en)`. URLs don't change.

**PostCSS** is unchanged (`tailwindcss: {}`):
- `tokens.css` picks the v2 config through `@config`.
- Legacy `globals.css` keeps `tailwind.config.ts`.
- **Cleanup when (legacy) is empty:** delete `(legacy)`, `globals.css` and `tailwind.config.ts`. Rename `tailwind.v2.config.ts` to `tailwind.config.ts`, drop the `@config` line, and merge the two v2 roots' shared parts.

**Cascade inside tokens.css:**
1. preflight
2. `@layer base`
3. unlayered primitives and grounds
4. `@layer components` (purged when unused)
5. utilities
6. user modes (win without `!important`, except Mode teks' overrides)

sections.title: 2 · Defects in the direction, and implementation traps (all verified)
sections.body_markdown:
**Direction defects (binding text changed here):**
1. **`--fs-title` 140px fails WCAG 1.4.4.** The clamp max/min is 8.75/3.25 = 2.69×. Above 2.5×, text can't reach 200% at wide viewports: at 500% zoom on a 1440 window the title only grows 1.86×.
   - Now `clamp(3.25rem, 1rem + 7.9vw, 8.125rem)`: 52 → 130px, ratio 2.5.
   - `:lang(id)` is ×.94: `clamp(3.055rem, .94rem + 7.426vw, 7.6375rem)`.
   - All other clamps are ≤2.33×.
2. **The one-face fallback `local('Roboto Condensed'), local('Arial Narrow'), Arial + size-adjust` can't be tuned.**
   - `size-adjust` is per face. At wdth 62 / 850, Arial Narrow Bold needs 85.9% and Arial Bold 70.4%.
   - The cuts also differ by up to 40% (the wdth 125 kicker and datelines need 126.7%, and they wrap).
   - Replaced by 13 faces: per cut, a Narrow family then an Arial/Roboto family. Measured in Chromium: every cut is within ±2.2% of Archivo (title −1.5, title-A −2.2, clock 0.0, svc −0.8, h3 −1.5, exp +0.1, wide +1.6, text +0.1, ui −0.4).
3. **Prompt P6 label contrast.** P6 sets 'ILUSTRASI · DATA CONTOH' in 12px `#EE3D5E` on Senja Dalam, which is **4.06:1 and fails AA** for small text. All mock labels use `.mock-label` in `--ink-2` (Cahaya 70, 7.69). Coral on Senja Dalam is large text or UI only.
4. **'Header swaps Putih ↔ Malam through ONE LogoFull's theme prop'.** A server-rendered header driven by `html[data-sky]` can't change a React prop without becoming a client component that re-renders on scroll.
   - Instead: the same single instance, `<LogoFull theme="light" className="logo-auto" />`, plus `.logo-auto tspan:first-of-type { fill: var(--logo-log) }`.
   - CSS beats SVG presentation attributes, and the values are exactly the prop's `#0A0118` / `#FFFFFF`.
   - The LogoFull visual-diff test covers it. Logo.tsx stays untouched.
5. **Dateline 16.30 'Siang'** (specimen): Indonesian usage is *Sore* for 15–16h. `hourInfo()` maps 04 Subuh, 05 Fajar, 06–10 Pagi, 11–14 Siang, 15–16 Sore, 17–19 Senja, 20–03 Malam.

**Traps found while building (not direction defects):**
- **Bare `:has()` in a selector list** (the pre-hydration sky selector) invalidates the *whole* rule on Firefox 111–120, which is in the repo browserslist. That would drop every dark ground there. Wrapped in forgiving `:is(…)`.
- **Tailwind 3.4 content globs with route groups:**
  - `\\(v2-id\\)` silently matches nothing, because Tailwind normalises the backslash away.
  - Bare `(v2-id)` is a glob group.
  - `[(]frontend[)]/[(]v2-id[)]` works (verified with the repo CLI).
- **`LogoFull` defaults to `theme='dark'`**, which paints a white 'Log' that disappears on paper. Lint: every `<LogoFull` must pass `theme=`.
- **`--font-sans` is real.** In Chromium the SVG attribute `font-family="var(--font-sans, …)"` resolves: undefined gives system-ui (94.1px), defined changes the wordmark (91.7px). Traps: next/font `variable: '--font-sans'`, shadcn presets, and a Tailwind v4 upgrade (its `@theme` defines `--font-sans` by default).
- **next/font emits `[hash]{-s}{.p}.woff2`.** A second `Archivo()` call with different `preload`/`adjustFontFallback` flags is a second 90 KB download. The escape-hatch alias must use identical flags.
- **Custom properties resolve where they are declared.** Derived tokens (`--key-ink`, `--key-num`, `--cursor-dot`, `--lamp`, `background-color`) are therefore declared inside every hour/stage/ground rule, never once on `:root`.
- **Archivo's served file has fvar default wght 600** (next's font-data says 400 as the CSS default). No impact, because every cut sets its weight.

sections.title: 3 · The hour / stage / ground system (pure CSS)
sections.body_markdown:
Three attributes, three jobs: | Attribute | Put it on | Sets | |---|---|---| | `data-hour="HHMM"` | page `
` or any `
` | key light (stage) **and** default ground, dateline hour | | `data-ground="putih\|kertas\|senja\|senja-dalam\|malam\|malam-dalam"` | section, inset, panel, card | surface + every ink role; overrides the hour's default | | `data-stage="ditemukan\|dipercaya\|dikutip\|dihubungi"` | chip, row, card, dial segment | key light only (`--key`, dots, rules); never a surface | Hour → stage by time-of-day prefix (total over all 24h; TS `hourInfo()` mirrors it, CI checks parity): | Prefix | Stage | `--key` | Default ground | Cursor dot | Lamp | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 04–09 | Ditemukan | Magenta | Kertas | magenta | off | | 10–16 | Dipercaya | Crimson | Putih | crimson | off | | 17–19 | Dikutip AI | Coral | Senja | coral | coral | | 20–23, 00–03 | Dihubungi | Jingga | Malam | jingga | jingga | Hours in use: - 0445 Subuh (house lights, footer) - 0530 hero, about (`data-ground="putih"`) - 0600 facts, table, hub, blog, legal - 0700 Bab I, SEO page, portfolio - 0830 Local SEO - 1240 Bab II, Social - 1510 Creative - 1630 Website - 1805 Bab III, AI page - 2030 Paid Ads - 2130 Bab IV, closing band, contact **How colour is resolved:** - Each stage declares `--ks-` candidates for SMALL key text, and **only the AA pairs**. Everything else is `initial`, so the ground's `--key-ink: var(--ks-, var(--ink))` falls back to neutral ink. - Magenta: Putih, Kertas. - Crimson: Putih only. - Coral: Senja only. - Jingga: Senja, Senja Dalam, Malam, Malam Dalam. - `--kn` covers numerals (large text): magenta, crimson or coral on paper; jingga is `initial`. On dark, numerals are Cahaya. ```html
…hero…

JAKARTA, 18.05 WIB — SENJA · DIKUTIP AIBab III

…instrument…
…SEO/AEO/GEO table…
…
``` **Rules:** - A ground re-resolves key text for its own element. A card that needs stage-coloured *text* carries both `data-stage` and `data-ground`; `
` and CrossSell do this. `data-stage` alone recolours graphics only. - **Header and phone bar:** - By default they are Putih. - `html[data-sky="dark"]` (written by SiteObserver from the computed `--sky` of the section under the header) switches them to Malam. - Before hydration, `main[data-sky="dark"]` does the same through a forgiving `:is(:root:not([data-sky]):has(…))`, so contact, Paid Ads and AI pages paint the right pill on the first frame. - Each ground also sets: - `color-scheme` (native checkboxes, details, scrollbars) - `--wa-edge`, `--error`, `--logo-log`, `--cursor-disc`, `--lamp` - body size: dark grounds set `--fs-body` ≥17px and `font-size`. - Verified in Chromium: 11 hours × 7 ground states = 77 cells. Each checks dateline, nested-Kertas dateline, numeral, ink, ink-2, link, ink button and WhatsApp against the computed background. 0 failures. The header flips Malam → Putih when `html[data-sky=light]`.

sections.title: 4 · Token × surface AA matrix (computed from tokens.css; check.mjs)
sections.body_markdown:
Full grid (WCAG 2.x ratio). **Bold = allowed as small text**, *italic = large text / UI only*. Everything else is banned for text.

| token \\ surface | Putih | Kertas | Semburat | Senja | Senja Dalam | Malam | Malam Dalam |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aspal | **18.55** | **16.97** | **13.88** | 1.06 | 1.19 | 1.02 | 1.16 |
| Aspal 70 | **9.01** | **8.25** | **6.74** | 1.95 | 1.73 | 2.02 | 1.78 |
| Magenta | **6.66** | **6.09** | **4.98** | 2.64 | 2.34 | 2.74 | 2.41 |
| Crimson | **4.95** | *4.53* | 3.71 | 3.55 | 3.15 | 3.68 | 3.24 |
| Coral | *3.84* | *3.52* | 2.88 | **4.57** | *4.06* | 4.75 (unused by rule) | 4.18 |
| Jingga | 2.52 | 2.30 | 1.88 | **6.98** | **6.20** | **7.25** | **6.38** |
| Cahaya | 1.12 | 1.02 | 1.19 | **15.70** | **13.94** | **16.30** | **14.35** |
| Cahaya 70 | 2.03 | 1.86 | 1.52 | **8.66** | **7.69** | **8.99** | **7.91** |
| Garis (UI) | 3.52 ¹ | 3.22 ¹ | – | – | – | – | – |
| Garis gelap (new) | – | – | – | 3.83 ¹ | 3.40 ¹ | 3.97 ¹ | 3.50 ¹ |
| WhatsApp | 1.98 ² | 1.81 ² | – | 8.86 ¹ | 7.86 | 9.20 ¹ | 8.09 |
| WA Label | 14.83 ¹ | 13.57 ¹ | – | – | – | – | – |

¹ Non-text boundary (≥3:1). ² Needs the 1.5px `#0A2E17` inset edge.

**Fills (label on fill):**

| Fill | Label | Ratio | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Aspal | white | 18.55 | ink button |
| Cahaya | Malam | 16.30 | partner button on dark |
| WhatsApp | WA Label | 7.48 | WhatsApp button (Aspal would be 9.35) |
| Magenta | white | 6.66 | key fill |
| Crimson | white | 4.95 | 'Paling populer' only |
| Coral | Aspal | 4.83 | key fill |
| Jingga | Aspal | 7.37 | key fill |

**Non-text:**
- Focus: Aspal on paper (16.97–18.55); Jingga on dark (6.20–7.25).
- Key rules and dots: magenta and crimson on paper, coral on Senja, jingga on Malam.
- Stage dots on the 'wrong' ground (e.g. a magenta dot on Senja, 2.64) are decorative; the stage name is always text.

**Banned pairs (lint + check.mjs):**
- **Text on paper:** Coral on paper (3.84 / 3.52) and Jingga on paper (2.52 / 2.30).
- **Text on dark:** Magenta on any dark ground (2.34–2.74); Crimson text on dark (3.15–3.68).
- **Fills:** white on WhatsApp (1.98), coral (3.84) or jingga (2.52).
- **Boundaries:** a green fill without the inset edge on paper (1.98 / 1.81).
- **Inside Stabilo:** a jingga link (1.88). Stabilo is paper-only, and `.stabilo a` is hard-set to magenta (4.98).
- **Allowed by WCAG but banned by house rule:**
  - Crimson SMALL text on Kertas (4.53, margin rule) → `--ks-kertas: initial`.
  - Coral SMALL text on Senja Dalam (4.06).
  - Coral on Malam (4.75): the night accent is orange only.
- The logo wordmark `#A855F7` is exempt as a logotype (3.96 / 3.62 / 4.44 / 4.61) and appears only on Putih, Kertas, Senja and Malam.

**How it is enforced (four layers):**
1. **The Tailwind theme exposes no raw text colours.** `textColor` holds only ground-resolved roles (`text-ink`, `text-ink-2`, `text-key-ink`, `text-key-num`, `text-link`, `text-error`, `text-btn-ink`, `text-on-key`, `text-wa-label`). `text-coral` does not exist (verified: the build drops it).
2. **The CSS allow-list is the matrix.** check.mjs parses every `--ks-*` / `--kn` and fails if one names a pair outside the allowed list. Mutation test: injecting `--ks-kertas: crimson` fails.
3. **Computed check.** check.mjs `--browser` renders all hour × ground cells and checks computed colours.
4. **Grep lint:** no hex or `rgba()` in `src/components/{ds,sections}`.

**Structural rule (from the direction):** every text node sits on one of the six flat grounds or inside Semburat. Nothing sits on photo, film, canvas or the horizon.

**Accessibility modes:**
- `prefers-contrast: more` swaps `--ink-2` → `--ink` and `--hair` → `--line`.
- `forced-colors` turns Stabilo into an underline and hides the horizon, spill, dial and `[data-decor]`. Buttons keep a 1.5px transparent border, which forced colours makes visible.

sections.title: 5 · Type system: next/font, cuts, fallbacks, --font-sans trap
sections.body_markdown:
**Families:**
- Archivo variable, one preloaded latin woff2 (wdth 62–125 × wght 100–900), **90,096 B**.
- Martian Mono 400, lazy, **10,376 B**.
- Total 100,472 B (98.1 KiB). No italic file, no serif.
- Banned faces: Bricolage, Outfit, Space Grotesk, Manrope, Inter, Geist, any serif.

```ts
// src/styles/fonts.ts (type-checked against repo next 16.2.6)
export const archivo = Archivo({ subsets: ['latin'], axes: ['wdth'], display: 'swap', preload: true,
  adjustFontFallback: false, variable: '--font-archivo' })
export const martian = Martian_Mono({ subsets: ['latin'], weight: '400', display: 'swap', preload: false,
  adjustFontFallback: false, variable: '--font-martian' })
// <html lang="id" className={`${archivo.variable} ${martian.variable}`} suppressHydrationWarning>
// <head> pre-paint: add .js; restore .mode-teks from localStorage('lk-mode-teks')
```

- With `adjustFontFallback: false` and no `fallback`, `--font-archivo` is only the hashed family. The stacks `--ff-text` … `--ff-mono` live in tokens.css.
- Widths come from `font-stretch: 62%|74%|88%|100%|125%`, which maps to the wdth axis via the @font-face range. Not `font-variation-settings`: that doesn't cascade per property and would also hit fallbacks.

**Cuts** (class = the whole cut; utilities may override single properties):

| Class | Stack | Stretch / weight | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.t-title` | ff-title | 62 / 850 caps, lh .86, ws .14em | home H1 lines + 4 chapter titles only |
| `.t-wide` | ff-wide | 125 / 300 caps, .64× title | Kata Lebar, max one per headline |
| `.t-kicker` | ff-exp | 125 / 620 caps +.06em | keyword part of home H1 |
| `.t-clock` | ff-title | 62 / 300 tnum | chapter numerals, color `--key-num` |
| `.t-h1svc` (+ `.tail`) | ff-mid | 74 / 780 sentence case; tail 100 / 500 ≥18px | service H1 |
| `.t-h2` | ff-mid | 74 / 760 | H2 |
| `.t-h3` | ff-h3 | 88 / 650 | H3 |
| `.t-lead`, `.t-body`, `.t-ui`, `.t-small` | ff-text | 100 / 400–650 | copy + UI |
| `.t-stat` | ff-title | 62 / 300 tnum | stats |
| `.t-dateline`, `.chip`, `.mock-label` | ff-exp | 125 / 600 caps +.08–.12em | datelines, chips, labels |
| `.t-mono`, `.t-caption` | ff-mono | 400 | instruments, captions |

**Fallback faces** (tokens.css §2; size-adjust = Archivo width ÷ fallback width; ascent/descent = 878/210 ÷ size-adjust):

| Family | Local source | Weight | size-adjust |
|---|---|---|---|
| LK Text | Arial / Liberation Sans / Roboto | 100–550 | 98.6% |
| LK Text | Arial Bold | 551–900 | 97.3% |
| LK Title N | Arial Narrow (Roboto Condensed) | 100–500 | 78.2% |
| LK Title N | Arial Narrow Bold | 501–900 | 85.9% |
| LK Title A | Arial | 100–500 | 64.1% |
| LK Title A | Arial Bold | 501–900 | 70.4% |
| LK Mid N | Narrow Bold | all | 97.0% |
| LK Mid A | Arial Bold | all | 79.6% |
| LK H3 A | Arial Bold | all | 87.6% |
| LK Exp A | Arial Bold | all | 126.7% |
| LK Wide A | Arial | all | 126.3% |
| LK Mono C | Consolas (Martian advance .70em) | all | 127.3% |
| LK Mono A | Menlo / DejaVu / Droid / Roboto Mono / Courier New | all | 116.3% |

**CLS guard:**
- **Display lines:** each line is `span.ln` (`display: block; white-space: nowrap`) with a fixed unitless line-height inside `overflow-x: clip`. Line count and box height can't change on swap, so display CLS = 0 whatever the fallback.
- **Wrapping text** (body, h3, kicker, datelines): the measured faces keep widths within ±2.2%.
- **Escape hatch:** a second `Archivo()` alias with identical flags and `display: 'optional'` for `--ff-title/-mid/-wide`. Verify one woff2 request in the Network panel.
- **Measure** CLS at 390 and 1440 on throttled 4G.

**Authoring rules:**
- **H1 textContent:** `DisplayLines` inserts literal `' '` text nodes between line spans, or `h1.textContent` concatenates words ('DITEMUKAN.DIPERCAYA.') and the CI H1-string test fails.
- **Missing glyphs:** the latin file lacks → (U+2192) and ≤ (U+2264), and so does Martian. Arrows are the `Icon` SVG; copy avoids ≤. ↑ ↓ — ° · × are present.
- **--font-sans:** never define it. CI grep: `rg -n -e '--font-sans\s*:' -e "variable:\s*['\"]--font-sans" src` must be empty. The Tailwind theme has no `fontFamily.sans` key; Tailwind 3 emits no theme variables.

sections.title: 6 · Tailwind 3.4 mapping (what exists, what deliberately doesn't)
sections.body_markdown:
**Replaced** (defaults removed, so off-system classes can't be written):
- `colors`: only `transparent`, `current`, `inherit`.
- `fontFamily`: `text`, `title`, `mid`, `h3`, `exp`, `wide`, `mono`. No `sans`.
- `fontSize`: `caption`, `dateline`, `mono`, `small`, `ui`, `body`, `lead`, `h3`, `kicker`, `h2`, `h1-svc`, `stat`, `wide`, `title`, `clock`, all mapped to `--fs-*` with line-height.
- `borderRadius`: `none`, `DEFAULT` = `ui` = 4px, `full` = chip. No `rounded-lg`.
- `boxShadow`: `none`, `wa-edge`. No shadows.
- `zIndex`: the named scale.
- `transitionTimingFunction`: `linear`, `out`, `ui`, `drawer`, `in-out`, `in`.
- `screens`: Tailwind defaults (sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280, 2xl 1536) + `fine` + `desk` raw media.

**Extended:**

| Key | Values |
|---|---|
| `textColor` | roles only (§4) |
| `backgroundColor` | `surface`, `surface-alt`, `btn`, `wa`, `key`, `hair`, `line` |
| `borderColor` | `DEFAULT` = `hair`, `line`, `key`, `focus`, `wa-label` |
| `outlineColor`, `ringColor` | `focus` |
| `placeholderColor` | `ink-2` |
| `fill`, `stroke` | roles |
| `fontWeight` | 620, 650, 760, 780, 850 |
| `letterSpacing` | `title`, `display`, `kicker`, `dateline` |
| `lineHeight` | `title`, `clock`, `svc`, `wide`, `lead`, `body` |
| `spacing` | `gutter`, `col-gap`, `section`, `section-sm`, `nav`, `bar`, `tap`, `dial`, `horizon`, `stage` |
| `minHeight` / `height` | `hero`, `stage`, `tap`, `horizon`, `runway` = calc(4 × --stage-h) |
| `maxWidth` | `grid`, `measure`, `lead`, `svc` |
| `transitionDuration` | `press`, `hover`, `ui`, `page-out`, `reveal`, `rise`, `image` |
| `aspectRatio` | `film` 21/9, `poster` 4/3, `still` 4/5, `canvas` 16/9, `og` 1200/630, `phone` 9/19.5, `thumb` 4/3 |

- Tailwind's 4px spacing scale is kept as-is (no custom numeric scale).
- The ribbon is **not** exposed as `bg-*`. It exists only as `.ribbon-horizon` (RibbonHorizon component), so 'one per page' is countable.
- Alpha modifiers (`bg-ink/50`) don't work on purpose: no tints outside the defined tokens.
- Verified with repo Tailwind 3.4.19:
  - Emitted: `.t-title`, `.btn-wa`, `.shadow-wa-edge`, `.py-section`, `.text-key-num`, `.max-w-measure`, `desk:block`, `.bg-surface`, `.rounded`.
  - Absent: `text-coral`, `rounded-lg`, `shadow-md`, `bg-white`, `text-gray-500`, legacy-only `p-[13px]`, `--font-sans:`, `scroll-behavior:smooth`.
- The **content globs** exclude legacy on purpose: legacy utilities would bloat the inlined CSS.

```ts
content: ['./src/components/ds/**/*.{ts,tsx}', './src/components/sections/**/*.{ts,tsx}',
  './src/app/[(]frontend[)]/[(]v2-id[)]/**/*.{ts,tsx}', './src/app/[(]frontend[)]/[(]v2-en[)]/**/*.{ts,tsx}']
```

sections.title: 7 · Rules: motifs, gradients, honesty captions, logo, dark share, Mode teks
sections.body_markdown:
**Recurring micro-motifs: cap of three.**
1. **Dateline** (`Dateline`, `.dateline`).
2. **Day dial** (`DayDial`: progress strip, hero stage strip, service 'Posisi di loop').
3. **Stabilo** (`Stabilo`, paper only).

'Recurring' means it appears in two or more sections of one page. A fourth motif needs a DESIGN.md change that removes one of these. The clock numeral is part of the home chapter-opener anatomy (4×, home only), not a motif.

Permanently cut:
- sticky chapter labels, column rules, grain overlay, slugs, timecodes, HUD brackets, letterbox bars, corner ticks, scan cursor
- tilt-glare cards, time-scrub thumbnails, velocity marquee
- gradient words, orbs, dot grids, glass, shadows, icon tiles, rounded-lg cards
- announcement bar, pulse-glow FAB, count-ups

**Gradients.**
- **The ribbon:** the only ribbon graphic is `RibbonHorizon`. It appears once per page, only on `/`, `/en` and the AI page pair, text-free and logo-free, 160–280px (px-capped), with 2% static noise. Every other page shows the ribbon only in the logo.
- **Four permitted non-ribbon gradients, all text-free or reading as flat:**
  - the Stabilo hard-stop band
  - the house-lights Semburat spill (≤48px, above the sheet)
  - the day-dial hard segments
  - the cursor Lamp's pre-blurred radial (only over film, photo or dark grounds)
- **Never:** gradient text, gradient buttons (`--grad-cta` dies), mesh, glows, animated `background-color` / gradient / `@property` / `filter` on full-bleed areas.
- **CI:** count `.ribbon-horizon` per rendered route (≤1, allowed routes only).

**Photo, film and mock honesty.**
- **Captions** (`Caption` → `<figcaption class="t-caption">`):
  - AI still: `Foto: ilustrasi AI · {tempat}, {HH.MM} WIB · bukan klien Logink` / `Photo: AI illustration · {place}, {HH.MM} WIB · not a Logink client`.
  - Film: `Foto/film: ilustrasi AI · bukan klien Logink`.
  - Owner-supplied client imagery: `Foto: {klien}, digunakan dengan izin`.
- **Asset manifest:**
  - `src/content/asset-manifest.ts` records file, kind (ai|client|stock), place, hour, prompt, model and date.
  - `Media` requires an asset key, and CI fails if an `ai` asset renders without a caption.
  - Metadata is stripped on WebP export; originals are archived.
- **Mocks:** `MockFrame` adds 'Ilustrasi · data contoh' / 'Illustration · sample data' in `--ink-2` and `data-nosnippet`. No dates, no narrative clock, no 'Live', no third-party logos or chrome.
- **Footer line:** 'Ilustrasi dibuat dengan bantuan AI; klien, testimoni, tim dan hasil adalah nyata.'
- **Never generated:** clients, testimonials, team, portfolio work, offices presented as Logink's, results.
- **Never:** text on photo, film, canvas, parallax layers or the horizon.

**Logo placement** (`src/components/ui/Logo.tsx` is never edited).
- **Grounds:**
  - `LogoFull` only on Putih or Kertas with `theme="light"`, and on Senja or Malam with `theme="dark"`.
  - Never on Senja Dalam or Malam Dalam panels, Semburat, the horizon, a key-colour fill, photo, film or canvas.
- **Always pass `theme` explicitly.** The default 'dark' is invisible on paper. Lint: `rg -nP '<LogoFull(?![^>]*theme=)' src` must be empty.
- **Header:** exactly one instance, `theme="light" className="logo-auto"`, with the CSS fill override driven by `--logo-log`. No hidden twin.
- **Gradient ids** are fixed strings, so:
  - no Logo inside a `display:none` ancestor that precedes a visible one (closed dialogs, responsive twins)
  - the mobile `<dialog>` comes after the header and holds no Logo.
- **Sizes and handling:**
  - Header mark height 28px (24px on phones).
  - Footer giant: `LogoFull` at width 100% of `.wrap`, height auto.
  - Clear space ≥0.5× mark height; minimum 24px height.
  - No recolour, stroke, rotation or animation (a page-transition crossfade is fine).
  - `LogoMark` alone is for favicon / icon.svg only.
- **CI:** Playwright visual diff of the header logo in both skies and the footer logo against a baseline, plus the `--font-sans` grep.

**Dark-band share.**
- **Caps by page type:**
  - Home: target ≈25%, cap 30% of document height (horizon + Senja + Malam + closing band).
  - Standard service pages, blog, legal, about, portfolio: closing band only, ≤15%.
  - SEO AI and Paid Ads (dark hero): ≤35%.
  - Contact (Malam hero): ≤40%.
- Long reading always sits on paper. Dark grounds force body text ≥17px by token.
- A dark section holds no paragraph over 60 words; longer answers go in a Kertas inset.
- **Measured** in the tall-viewport Playwright script: summed heights of sections whose computed `--sky` = dark, divided by document height, at 412×12140 and 1440×900.

**Mode teks** ('Mode teks · Lihat halaman ini seperti AI membacanya' / 'Text mode · See this page the way AI reads it').
- **Where it lives:** one `<input type="checkbox" id="mode-teks">` in the footer on every page; Bab III and the AI page have `<label for="mode-teks">`. No URL, no query parameter, not indexable.
- **What the CSS does** (`:root:is(.mode-teks, :has(#mode-teks:checked))`):
  - every stack becomes Martian and every ground becomes Kertas / Aspal
  - hides img, picture, video, canvas, iframe, `[data-decor]`, the horizon, the dial and the cursor layer
  - collapses display cuts to 18px bold, prefixes headings with `#` / `##` / `###`
  - no animations or transitions.
- **JS side:** SiteObserver persists the choice to `localStorage('lk-mode-teks')`; a pre-paint script restores `.mode-teks`. FilmLoop, ScrollSequence and MotionRoot check it before loading, so it doubles as a data and motion off switch.
- **Test:** usability-test it once. If it confuses visitors, keep only the Bab III label.

**Buttons and WhatsApp.**
- The only fills are Aspal (light), Cahaya (dark) and `#25D366`. Crimson is a badge and key light only, and never sits next to WhatsApp.
- WhatsApp is always `<a>` to wa.me via `waLink()`, with a `#0A2E17` label and glyph and the inset edge on paper. Green is used on WhatsApp controls only.
- Body links are always underlined.
- Radii: 0 on sections, cards and tables; 4px on buttons, inputs and media; pills on chips only.

sections.title: 8 · Admin stays untouched; DESIGN.md v2 outline
sections.body_markdown:
**Admin isolation.**
- `src/app/(payload)/admin/layout.tsx` is a separate root layout. It imports only `@payloadcms/next/css`, and its importMap holds only Payload built-ins (no custom admin components import frontend UI; verified).
- `tokens.css` is imported only by the `(v2-id)` / `(v2-en)` roots.
- Tailwind v2 content globs never include `(payload)` or `src/collections`.
- No design-system package adds global element selectors outside tokens.css. Base rules there are safe because the file loads only under v2 roots.
- The `.theme-dark-admin` block in `globals.css` is dead: no element uses it. It is deleted with `(legacy)`.
- The MEMORY note 'admin stays dark' is outdated: the admin is Payload's stock UI. Update it after the pilot.
- **Checks:**
  - `rg -n "tokens.css|tailwind.tokens" "src/app/(payload)"` must be empty.
  - A Playwright screenshot of `/admin/login` before and after must be identical.
- **Payload config:** no schema changes for the design system. The CMS `services.color` legacy hexes are ignored: accents come from the registry stage, never from `svc.color` or `industryRel.accentColor`. `ACCENT_REMAP` / `COLOR_REMAP` are deleted.

**Replacing DESIGN.md.**
- **Pilot:** v1 (Warm Canvas, 53 lines) stays as `DESIGN.md` while legacy pages exist. `docs/DESIGN-v2.md` lands with the pilot.
- **Phase 6 cleanup:** move v2 to `DESIGN.md`, delete v1, and add a `CHANGELOG` line ('2026-10 Sehari Semalam replaces Warm Canvas (2026-07); owner sign-off on spec-1440.jpg').

**Outline for DESIGN.md v2:**
0. Status, scope, owner sign-off; what never changes (Logo.tsx, admin, URLs).
1. Thesis in five lines: one Jakarta day; four ribbon stops = four stages = four hours.
2. Files and loading contract (tokens.css, tailwind.tokens.ts, tailwind.v2.config.ts, fonts.ts, root layouts, check-tokens).
3. **Colour:**
   - primitives
   - roles
   - the hour / stage / ground system (tables from §3)
   - the allowed matrix (generated by `check-tokens.mjs --md`) and banned pairs
   - WhatsApp rules.
4. **Type:**
   - two families, the next/font setup, cuts table, fallback faces
   - the CLS guard and DisplayLines authoring
   - glyph gaps
   - the `--font-sans` trap.
5. **Layout:** 12-column grid and gutters, section anatomy (dateline, numeral, title, lead, photo), the home rhythm Putih → Kertas → Putih → Kertas → Putih → horizon → Senja → Malam → Kertas, radii, hairlines, z-index, breakpoints and T0–T3 tiers.
6. The three motifs plus the cut list.
7. Gradient and light rules (ribbon once, spill, lamp).
8. Imagery and honesty (captions, manifest, never-generated list, day/night grade, Indonesia checklist).
9. Logo rules.
10. **Motion:**
    - tokens
    - T0–T3 tiers with phone and reduced-motion fallbacks
    - restraint rules (one scroll signature per viewport, ≤2 infinite animations, ≤6-item stagger)
    - Mode teks.
11. Component inventory by folder (`ds/`, `ds/chrome`, `ds/motion`, `ds/instruments`, `sections/*`), with server/client and tier.
12. **Accessibility and SEO guards:** AA matrix in CI, focus, underlined links, clamp ratio ≤2.5, forced colours, prefers-contrast, no text on imagery, SSR contract, H1 string test, JSON-LD visible-text test.
13. Page recipes: the home order, the service template (15 blocks), and the hub, about, portfolio, case, blog, legal and contact lights.
14. Budgets: fonts, CSS, JS, LCP / TBT / CLS, and dark-band share.
15. CI commands (§9 of this blueprint).
16. Decisions log: owner defaults and deviations (the five defects fixed here, live-HTML UI motion instead of WebM, and so on).

sections.title: 9 · CI checks and commands
sections.body_markdown:
```bash
# 1. token matrix + CSS allow-list + hour parity + computed contrast + fallback widths
npx tailwindcss -i src/styles/tokens.css -o /tmp/lk.css && \
  ARCHIVO_WOFF2=scripts/fixtures/archivo-latin.woff2 node scripts/check-tokens.mjs --browser /tmp/lk.css
# 2. the logo trap
rg -n -e '--font-sans\s*:' -e "variable:\s*['\"]--font-sans" src && exit 1
rg -nP '<LogoFull(?![^>]*theme=)' src && exit 1
# 3. no raw colour outside tokens
rg -n -e '#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}\b' -e 'rgba?\(' src/components/ds src/components/sections && exit 1
# 4. classes that don't exist in the v2 theme (Tailwind drops them silently)
rg -n -e 'text-(coral|jingga|magenta|crimson)\b' -e 'rounded-(lg|xl|2xl)' -e 'shadow-(sm|md|lg|xl)' -e 'bg-gradient' src/components/ds src/components/sections && exit 1
# 5. admin isolation
rg -n 'tokens.css|tailwind.tokens' 'src/app/(payload)' && exit 1
```

- **Numbers verified on 2026-09-27:**
  - `check.mjs` passes: 54 allowed pairs, 17 banned pairs confirmed, the allow-list is clean, 24/24 hours match, 77/77 browser cells pass, and all 10 fallback cuts are within ±2.2%.
  - The mutation run fails as intended: an injected crimson-on-Kertas pair and a 17h drift are both reported.
  - `tsc --strict` passes on `tailwind.tokens.ts`, `tailwind.v2.config.ts` and `fonts.ts`.
- **Tall-viewport script (belongs with the SEO and motion keys; the design system supplies the selectors):**
  - 0 hidden text at 412×732 and 412×12140
  - document-height ratio ≤1.5
  - `.ribbon-horizon` count ≤1 on allowed routes only
  - dark share (sections whose computed `--sky` is dark) within the caps in §7.
- **Budgets (measured or derived):**
  - Fonts: 100,472 B with 1 preload.
  - v2 CSS: ≤40 KB raw inlined per page; the full component set measures 26.3 KB.
  - The first load ships no motion library.
  - Client leaves in the initial chunk: SiteObserver (~1.2 KB), MenuButton (~0.2 KB), TocSpy (~0.3 KB, blog/legal only).
  - Everything else is dynamic behind MEDIA.rich or MEDIA.canvas.
- **Skipped (YAGNI):**
  - A stylelint plugin; the four greps plus the theme's missing classes cover it.
  - Token export to Figma or Style Dictionary; add it when a design tool consumes the tokens.

page-architecture.summary:
Complete information architecture for the 'Sehari Semalam' redesign of logink.co (read-only; repo on feat/payload-cms @ e85adf9, Next 16.2.6).

Coverage:
- URL map: 14 code-owned ID/EN pairs, 3 case-study pairs, 4 posts (3 with EN twins), 5 category pairs, the 404 and 3 infra routes are all kept. One pair is new-additive: /layanan/jasa-seo-ai + /en/services/ai-search-optimization, behind the AI_PAGE_LIVE flag (owner decision 1).
- Redirects: 27 generated next.config 308s, including the missing /services/local-seo, /index, /en/index and the 5 legacy /layanan/<cms-slug> duplicates. Another 7 308s come from page code (the EN routes currently serve ID slugs). The www redirect is still a 307 and must become a 308.
- Templates: 14, specified section by section with data source, owner ingredient and motion tier T0–T3.

One registry drives nav, footer, LanguageLink, sitemap, llms.txt, JSON-LD, cross-links, WhatsApp prefills, H1/title/meta and the redirects. The draft is scratchpad/blueprint/page-architecture/services.ts. Its check (services.check.ts) passes: 7 services, 8 pages, 14 pairs, 27 redirects; titles ≤60; descriptions 120–160; no redirect chains or shadowed live pages; 'Rp 1 Juta' always carries 'ditagih tahunan'. A negative test confirms the check does fail when a rule is broken.

Defects found in the chosen direction (details in the first section):
1. The approved AI H1 omits 'GEO & AEO', which §8 requires.
2. No Social or Creative module prices exist, although the template says they render.
3. No Maps iframe exists on Local SEO.
4. Per-locale root layouts need global-not-found.
5. LanguageLink cannot live in a layout, so the chrome moves into a per-page PageFrame.

Defects found on the live site:
1. priceRange and alternateName would fail the check that every JSON-LD string is visible text.
2. /blog/category/<anything> returns 200 and is indexable (a soft 404).
3. The sitemap is static-cached at deploy time and lists 1 of 4 posts.
4. The legacy /layanan/<cms-slug> pages canonicalise to URLs that redirect.

sections.title: 1. Defects and clarifications vs the chosen direction (binding unless noted) and the live site
sections.body_markdown:
Defects in final.md, each with its resolution:
1. **AI page H1.** §8 says the title and H1 name 'GEO & AEO', but the approved H1 'Jasa SEO AI: Brand Anda Dikutip di Google AI Overview, AI Mode, dan ChatGPT' does not. Proposed fix (smallest change): 'Jasa SEO AI (GEO & AEO): Brand Anda Dikutip di Google AI Overview, AI Mode, dan ChatGPT'. Pending owner sign-off; the registry keeps the approved string with a DEFECT comment.
2. **'The Social and Creative builders render module prices as SSR text.'** No module prices exist: social/data.ts and creative/data.ts carry no prices, and live pages show 'proposal kustom dalam 24 jam'. The IA renders module and deliverable names plus the proposal note as SSR text. Indicative prices are an owner decision; no Offer node is emitted.
3. **'Maps iframe on Local SEO.'** No iframe exists; LocalSeoMap is an SVG mock. Don't add one unless Logink's own GBP exists (decision 8). If it is added: a click-to-load facade, data-lenis-prevent and data-cursor='hide'.
4. **Separate root layouts for SSR lang.** Giving each locale its own root layout (needed for a correct server-side `<html lang>`) means there is no single app-level not-found. Use app/global-not-found.tsx with experimental.globalNotFound, plus not-found.tsx in each locale root. Today unmatched URLs get Next's unstyled English default.
5. **LanguageSwitcher 'from the server pair map'.** A layout cannot know the pathname without dynamic headers(). The chrome therefore moves into a per-page PageFrame that receives alt={id,en}; usePathname is banned for SEO hrefs.
6. **Chapter clock numerals.** An aria-hidden child still counts in textContent, so the numerals must sit outside the H1/H2 element. Otherwise the CI h1.textContent test and the outline break.
7. **JSON-LD-visible CI.** The rule 'every JSON-LD string ≥20 chars must be visible' fails on today's localBusinessSchema priceRange 'Rp 1 Juta - Rp 50 Juta+' and alternateName 'Logink Digital Marketing Agency'. Drop both. Service.description must equal the visible Jawaban singkat, and Organization.description must equal the ENTITY sentence, which the footer makes visible on every page.
8. **'Ribbon once per page'** means the hub's Dikutip AI stage band is flat Senja with no horizon.
9. **Contract FAQ.** The home FAQ lists a contracts question, while 'tanpa lock-in' is off home until decision 6. The contract FAQ item is omitted until the owner reconciles.
10. **Pilot dependency.** The pilot (SEO page) is also the AI fallback target, so it must ship the expanded #ai-search section.

Live defects this IA fixes (verified 2026-09-27):
- The sitemap is static-cached at the 16 Jul deploy: 35 URLs, 1 of 4 posts, 0 categories, lastmod = build time.
- /blog/category/nope returns 200 with index,follow.
- EN routes serve ID slugs with a self-canonical.
- /layanan/<cms-slug> returns 200 while its canonical points at a /services URL that redirects.
- Every /en page ships `<html lang="id">`.
- There is no head hreflang outside blog posts.
- og-default.jpg and logo-light.svg are 404s.
- The FAB prefill is in English on ID pages.
- The Social hero WhatsApp link has no prefill.
- The Creative hero has no WhatsApp button.
- www redirects with a 307.

**Header** (desktop ≥1024) - Order: LogoFull → Layanan ▾ · Portofolio · Blog · Tentang → LanguageLink (ID | EN) → 'Minta Penawaran' (ink). - The fixed WhatsAppPill is a separate element that never hides. - EN labels: Services, Portfolio, Blog, About, Get a quote, Chat on WhatsApp. - The pill surface swaps Putih ↔ Malam from html[data-sky]: Malam on the Ads, Contact and Bab IV/closing grounds, Senja on the AI hero. **Mega menu: reconciling goals and stages** - The columns stay the live goal groups, which is what buyers scan. - Each item carries its stage chip. - A fourth row is the 4-stage strip linking the hub's stage bands. - Menu contents: - Tingkatkan Organik: Jasa SEO Profesional ·Ditemukan·, Local SEO & Google Maps ·Ditemukan·, Social Media Management ·Dipercaya·, SEO AI (GEO & AEO) ·Dikutip AI· (via svcHref, so it points to #ai-search until the page ships). - Tingkatkan Penjualan: Iklan Google & Meta Ads ·Dihubungi·, Website & Landing Page ·Dipercaya·. - Kreasi & Konten: Desain Grafis & Video ·Dipercaya·. **Mobile** - 56px header: logo · LanguageLink · menu button. - The menu repeats the groups, then Portofolio, Blog, Tentang, Kontak, LanguageLink, Penawaran and WhatsApp. - BottomActionBar: WhatsApp 60% / Penawaran 40% (WhatsApp only on /contact). It hides on field focus or when the dialog is open. - The FAB and announcement bar are removed, which also removes the 8px overflow. **Footer** - WhatsApp CTA → giant LogoFull → ENTITY. - Columns (

titles): Layanan (7), Perusahaan, Artikel (indexable categories), Kontak. - Then legal links, the Mode teks checkbox, AI_DISCLOSURE and ©. **Breadcrumbs** On every inner page, localised, mirrored 1:1 in BreadcrumbList. Levels: 2 on hubs and pages, 3 on services, cases, categories and posts.

sections.title: 5. Cross-linking rules and internal-link targets per page
sections.body_markdown:
**Rules**
1. Anchor text is always the service name from the registry. 'Selengkapnya' and 'Learn more' are banned (6 of each exist today).
2. Every service gets at least 3 SSR inlinks from every template through the chrome alone: mega menu, mobile dialog and footer. Body links come on top.
3. Every link to the AI page goes through svcHref('ai'), which points to /layanan/jasa-seo-profesional#ai-search while AI_PAGE_LIVE is false.
4. 'Posisi di loop' (service §05) lights this service's stage and links the services of the other stages via servicesInStage():
   - Ditemukan: SEO, Local SEO, +Ads.
   - Dipercaya: Social, Creative, Website, +Local SEO.
   - Dikutip AI: AI, +SEO, Local, Social, Creative, Website.
   - Dihubungi: Ads, +Website.
5. 'Cocok dikombinasikan dengan' = registry pairs plus the AI page last. The base is today's cross-sell links:
   - SEO → Ads, Website, Local SEO.
   - Local SEO → SEO, Website, Ads.
   - Ads → SEO, Creative, Website.
   - Social → Creative, Ads.
   - Creative → Social, Website.
   - Website → SEO, Ads.
   - AI → SEO, Local SEO, Social, Website.
6. Locale-correct hrefs everywhere. EN case and post cards use slugEn.
7. The Mode teks toggle creates no URL.

**In-body targets per page**
- **Home:** all 7 services (table + chapters), /layanan, /contact, the approved cases or /portfolio, svcHref('ai').
- **Hub:** all 7 services (table + bands), /contact, /portfolio.
- **Service:** crossLinks, the loop-strip services, /layanan#harga, approved cases, 1–2 posts from the mapped category (SEO → the 3 technical posts; Social → the engagement post), /contact?layanan=key.
- **About:** all 7 services (facts <dl>), /portfolio, /contact.
- **Portfolio:** the cases, the services used, the services without cases.
- **Case:** the services used, related cases, /contact.
- **Blog hub:** posts, indexable categories, the category-mapped service.
- **Category:** posts, the mapped service.
- **Post:** the mapped service CTA, the category, related posts (robots.txt post also → the AI page).
- **Contact:** /layanan.
- **Legal:** /contact.
- **404:** home, hub, all 7 services, blog, contact.

**Cannibalisation**
- The SEO page owns the 'jasa seo' terms.
- The AI page owns 'seo ai / GEO / AEO / AI Overview optimization'.
- Future glossary posts own 'Apa itu GEO' and 'Apa itu AEO' (with the customs disambiguation). Suggested slugs: /blog/apa-itu-geo and /blog/apa-itu-aeo, as additive CMS posts.

sections.title: 6. SEO/AEO system rules (all templates)
sections.body_markdown:
**Titles and meta**
- Titles are absolute, at most 60 characters, head term first, 'Jakarta' where it fits, brand last. Home keeps its brand-first title.
- Meta descriptions run 120–160 characters and carry a price anchor where the price is simple.
- A 'Rp 1 Juta' mention always carries 'ditagih tahunan'. An Ads price always carries 'management fee, di luar budget iklan'.
- services.check.ts enforces the length and price rules for the registry.

**H1 and headings**
- Exactly one H1, at display size, CI-asserted as h1.textContent === the registry string.
- Split only by line or word, using aria-label on the heading and aria-hidden spans.
- Chapter numerals sit outside headings.
- H2 order on service pages: value → deliverables → pricing → comparison → proof → process → FAQ → cross-sell → CTA.

**Answer-first blocks**
- The home entity lede, the 40–60-word Jawaban singkat on every service page, the Bab III lead, the post Ringkasan, and all FAQ answers (40–80 words, first sentence answers).
- Every answer sits under the Stabilo highlight.

**FAQ sources**
- Existing data.ts FAQs (7 per service) plus the seo-data PAA questions:
  - Home: 'Berapa biaya jasa digital marketing?', 'Digital marketing agency itu apa?'
  - SEO: 'Apa itu jasa SEO?', 'Berapa harga jasa SEO?', 'Apa jasa SEO terbaik di Indonesia?'
  - Website: 'Berapa biaya jasa bikin website?', 'Berapa harga situs web?', 'Joki website berapa?', 'Apakah ChatGPT bisa membuat website?'
  - Ads: 'Berapa harga jasa Google Ads?', 'Biaya Ads berapa?', 'Apakah Google Ads gratis?'
  - Social: 'Apa itu jasa manajemen media sosial?', 'Berapa harga jasa kelola sosmed?', 'Social media management tugasnya apa?'
- AI questions come from aeo-geo §4.2 and §4.3. Local SEO and Creative have no captured PAA: Local SEO keeps its 7, and Creative's additions are marked query-derived.
- Rendered as <details> with answers mounted. FAQPage JSON-LD is optional (the rich result was removed on 2026-05-07).

**hreflang**
- In <head> on every paired page: id, en, x-default → ID. Also in the sitemap (xhtml:link).
- Built from registry STATIC_PAIRS for code pages and from slug/slugEn with an EN body for CMS pages.
- Unpaired pages emit only their canonical.
- Two root layouts give the correct SSR lang. There are no automatic language redirects.

**Server HTML (the crawl contract)**
- Must be in the server HTML: every H1–H3, lede, answer, price, tier, builder module name, comparison table, FAQ answer, stat with its source, overture step, case metric sentence and the mega menu.
- Nothing is at opacity 0 at rest, and counters render their final values.
- Canvas, film, lamp, dial and horizon are aria-hidden.
- Mocks carry 'Ilustrasi · data contoh' and data-nosnippet.
- Islands receive ids and numbers, never paragraphs.
- CI runs the content-manifest curl test with scripts stripped and fails on '0 %', '0 +' or '0.0 ×'.

**Sitemap**
- Target after launch: 28 static URLs + 7 post URLs + 6 case URLs + 3 indexable categories = 44 URLs.
- lastmod: registry `updated` for code pages, CMS updatedAt for posts and cases, and the latest post for categories.
- The AI pair is added when it ships.

**llms.txt**
- Generated from the registry: ENTITY (ID + EN), 7 services with their line and price text, key pages, contact and 'Last updated'. No unsourced ROAS claim.

**robots.txt**
- Unchanged rules plus the aeo-geo §5.2 comment block. No per-bot groups. Don't opt out of AI features in GSC.

**OG images**
- One per page: 1200×630 JPEG ≤150 KB in the page's light, via ogFor(path, locale) → /og/{locale}/{leaf}.jpg.
- Posts: CMS ogImage, then featuredImage. Cases: CMS ogImage (Claude Design covers).

sections.title: 7. Structured data @graph per template
sections.body_markdown:
Stable @ids:
- https://logink.co/#organization
- https://logink.co/#website
- {url}#webpage, {url}#breadcrumb, {url}#service, {url}#article
- https://logink.co/about#{person-slug}

One JSON-LD script per page. All pages emit the Organization node (by reference on inner pages) and WebSite.

**Organization** (single node, @type ['Organization','ProfessionalService'])
- name Logink; url; logo ImageObject https://logink.co/images/logo-512.png; description = ENTITY[locale]; email; telephone +628139453933; address locality Jakarta, region DKI Jakarta, ID; sameAs [Instagram + owner-supplied LinkedIn/TikTok/YouTube/GBP]; knowsAbout.
- legalName, foundingDate, streetAddress and geo only when the owner supplies them.
- No priceRange, no alternateName, no aggregateRating.

**Per template**
- **Home:** Organization, WebSite (inLanguage ['id-ID','en'], publisher → org), WebPage (about → org, dateModified), FAQPage optional.
- **Hub:** CollectionPage, ItemList → {service}#service, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage optional.
- **Service:** WebPage (reviewedBy Person when REVIEWER is set), Service (description = Jawaban singkat, provider, areaServed, audience, offers from visible tiers only), BreadcrumbList, FAQPage optional.
- **About:** AboutPage, the full Organization, Person nodes when real, BreadcrumbList.
- **Portfolio:** CollectionPage, ItemList, BreadcrumbList.
- **Case:** Article (about the client org only when named, mentions services), BreadcrumbList.
- **Blog hub and category:** CollectionPage, ItemList (hub), BreadcrumbList.
- **Post:** BlogPosting (author Person @id, publisher @id), BreadcrumbList.
- **Contact:** ContactPage, Organization.contactPoint, BreadcrumbList.
- **Legal:** WebPage, BreadcrumbList.
- **404:** none.

Never emitted: VideoObject on the decorative film or loops, self-serving Review/AggregateRating, SearchAction.

CI: every JSON-LD string of 20+ characters must appear in visible text.

**Minta Penawaran target**
Always /contact?layanan={key}#formulir (EN: /en/contact?layanan={key}#formulir). The form preselects the service. The canonical stays /contact.

**Lead Profiler**

**Anti-scam line**
'Nomor WhatsApp resmi Logink hanya +62 813-9453-933.' / 'Logink's only official WhatsApp number is +62 813-9453-933.' It appears in the ClosingBand (every page), the Contact hero and FAQ, the footer Kontak column, the 404 and the Lead Profiler confirmation. The same WA_NUMBER constant feeds every prefill.

**Tracking**
- Every CTA stays a real <a> (GTM triggers keep firing).
- Attributes: data-cta = whatsapp | quote | profiler | form, data-placement = header | pill | bar | hero | table | tier | builder | faq | closing | footer | menu | profiler | case | post, data-service = key.
- One delegated listener in SiteObserver (T1) pushes dataLayer {event:'cta_click', cta, placement, service, page, locale}.
- Form and profiler success push {event:'lead_submit', source, service}.
- WhatsApp prefill text stays per page. It is the only lead attribution that survives without GA4.

motion-engineering.summary:
Motion engineering blueprint for 'Sehari Semalam', written as working code and checked against the repo's toolchain (read-only). A previous partial pass had left files in blueprint/motion-engineering. I reviewed them, fixed several defects, aligned them with the design-system blueprint's token and attribute contract, and added a test harness.

**Tiers and bytes (measured with esbuild -minify, gzip -9, React and Next external):**
- **T0 (CSS only):** motion.css is 4.4 KB gz minified and is inlined into the HTML, because the repo sets inlineCss: true.
- **T1 (every page):** SiteObserver, RichGate and gates together are 2.40 KB gz. Home adds the ScrollSequence island (0.96 KB gz). None of this pulls in a motion library.
- **T2 (desktop only):** one rich chunk of 16.86 KB gz (Lenis, framer-motion's springs and frame loop, and our cursor, hover still, loupe, film and drag code) plus the canvas player at 2.17 KB gz. Both load after window load, and only behind (hover:hover), (pointer:fine), no reduced motion, no Mode teks and a viewport no taller than 2000 px.
- **Phones:** 0 KB of motion JS. A body scan of every script a touch profile downloads found no motion markers.

**v2 uses no framer-motion React components.** Measured costs: full `motion` is 40.7 KB gz; LazyMotion + m + domAnimation is 27.3 KB gz; springValue + frame alone is 9.1 KB gz. LazyMotion/m is therefore a fallback policy for future leaves, enforced by an ESLint rule.

**ViewTransition works in the repo without the config flag.** Next 16.2.6 bundles React 19.3.0-canary-3f0b9e61-20260317, whose stable build exports ViewTransition, and react-dom calls document.startViewTransition. `experimental.viewTransition` is only declared in the schema; nothing in next/dist reads it. It is still worth setting.

**ScrollSequence.tsx was rewritten with the judges' fixes:**
- The runway is calc(4 × min(100svh, 900px)) and the sticky stage is --stage-h.
- The mobile frame tier and the effectiveType gate are gone. The old version also imported framer-motion's useScroll into the island, which would have put 7.8 KB gz on phones.
- Frames load after window load and only within one viewport, starting with the step frames (0, 40, 80, 119) and then filling in coarse to fine.
- Frames are decoded with createImageBitmap in a Worker, within a 128 MiB window (36 frames), and every bitmap is released when the section is offscreen or Mode teks turns on.
- The low-memory LOOP tier from final.md is restored.

**Checks run:**
- The repo's TypeScript 5.9.3 and its own ESLint rules (Next core-web-vitals and typescript) both pass with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- sequence-core.check.ts passes.
- On a server-rendered, hydrated fixture page, all five Playwright scripts pass (runtime, motion gate, states, tall viewport, perf) except perf-mobile. It correctly failed the fixture (TBT 253 ms, 207 KB JS) because the fixture serves an uncompressed React bundle and hydrates the whole page. It only proves the script works and must run on the Vercel preview.
- The canvas painted the frame the scroll position asked for within ±1 frame, including on reverse scrolling. Decoded bitmaps peaked at exactly 36, then dropped to 0 offscreen and after Mode teks.
- Cursor labels, tones and key-light dot colour, the 14 px magnetic clamp, the hover still, the loupe, the drag row, header states, html[data-sky], the dialog menu and the phone step band all behaved as specified.

**Defects found in the inputs:**
- The design-system house-lights band is sticky with no height guard, so on short viewports its WhatsApp button and anti-scam line get covered. A 640 px guard is added in motion.css.
- The tall-viewport test as written in final.md measures scrollHeight, which never goes below the viewport height, so any page shorter than 8,093 px fails falsely. The harness now uses content height.
- Several prior motion rules hid text with opacity 0 or permanently clipped it, and some animated background-color. All are fixed.

**Deliberate deviations from final.md, each with its reason, are in the 'Defects and deviations' section.**

interactions.name: Cursor dot + label disc (zones and labels)
interactions.where: All v2 pages; labelled zones: service rows 'Buka layanan'/'Open service', case cards 'Lihat studi kasus'/'View case study', case row gaps 'Geser'/'Drag', phase-2 film 'Putar film (0:45)'; WhatsApp controls tone=wa
interactions.desktop: 10px dot trails the always-visible native cursor (spring 900/55/0.25), coloured by the computed --cursor-dot of the element under the pointer (magenta/crimson on paper, coral on Senja, Jingga on Malam; read only when the [data-hour]/[data-ground]/[data-stage] element changes). Over [data-cursor] it becomes a 96px disc (spring 320/32/0.6): Aspal on light and Cahaya on dark (from computed --sky). data-cursor-tone='wa' gives a #25D366 disc with a #0A2E17 'Chat WhatsApp' label. The native cursor is hidden only inside labelled zones. The follower hides over input/textarea/select/iframe/video[controls]/contenteditable/[data-cursor=hide]. Pointer handlers only set springs and write attributes, with no React state.
interactions.phone: Not loaded (0 KB). Keyboard users see the same label as a :focus-visible::after chip.
interactions.reduced_motion: Not loaded; native cursor only; the focus-visible label remains
interactions.js_cost: Inside the rich chunk: 16.86 KB gz shared by all T2 effects (cursor code about 0.9 KB of it)

interactions.name: Lamp
interactions.where: Hero film frame (dawn light); Bab III Senja and Bab IV Malam bands ([data-lamp] with <i class='lk-lamp'>)
interactions.desktop: A pre-blurred 560px radial pool follows the pointer by transform only (spring 170/22/0.6), mix-blend-mode: screen, under the text. Colour comes from the design-system --lamp: Semburat on the hero (.lk-film overrides it), the stage key on dark grounds, and transparent (off) on paper. It fades in on zone hover (400ms).

interactions.name: Magnetic CTAs
interactions.where: Chat WhatsApp + Minta Penawaran in the hero, the closing band, the footer and the nav CTA ([data-magnetic] wrapper)
interactions.desktop: The inner CTA leans toward the pointer by the `translate` property, at most 14px at strength 0.35 (spring 220/16/0.4), and springs back with a small overshoot. The wrapper is measured and never transformed. Verified on the fixture: '14px 7.7px' at the edge.
interactions.phone: The design-system .btn:active scale(.97) press (transform), which composes with translate
interactions.reduced_motion: Press scale only (duration clamped by the global RM rule)

interactions.name: Hover-reveal still on the services table
interactions.where: Home section 03 'Layanan & harga' (one real <table>) and the /layanan hub
interactions.desktop: A 240px 4:5 still (≤50 KB WebP, all 7 created on first table entry) trails the pointer with ±10° velocity rotation (spring 170/22/0.6) and crossfades between rows (240ms). The row tint is instant; the name nudges 12px (150ms); the stage dot fills. The 'Buka layanan' disc shows, and a mouse click anywhere on a row follows its <a>.
interactions.phone: Inline 96×72 thumbnails (lazy). Below 768px rows reflow into blocks and explicit ARIA table roles keep the semantics.
interactions.js_cost: Rich chunk (shared); images 7 × ≤50 KB desktop-only on first hover

interactions.name: Proof Loupe
interactions.where: Bab III 'Di balik layar' and the AI page instruments
interactions.desktop: A 200px round lens (overflow hidden) moves by transform (spring 900/55/0.25). A clone of the aria-hidden annotation layer inside it is counter-translated so the notes stay registered, so no clip-path or mask repaint occurs. The follower hides over the zone.
