sections.title: 1. Architecture: tiers, gates and the 0 KB phone rule
sections.body_markdown:
**Tiers**
- **T0, CSS only.** `src/motion/motion.css` (4.4 KB gz minified, inlined because `experimental.inlineCss: true`) plus the design-system `tokens.css`. Works with JS off. Every animation sits inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`, and every scroll-driven one also inside `@supports (animation-timeline: view()|scroll())`. Unsupported browsers get the static final state.
- **T1, 2.40 KB gz on every page.** `SiteObserver.tsx` (1.41) + `RichGate.tsx` (0.36) + `gates.ts` (0.63), plus `ScrollSequence.tsx` (0.96) on home. No motion library.
- **T2, rich desktops only.**
  - `RichGate` runs `import('./rich')`: 16.86 KB gz, made of Lenis 1.3.23, framer-motion 12.38 `springValue`/`frame`/`cancelFrame` (the motion-dom chunk, 9.08), and our cursor, hover still, loupe, films and drag code.
  - `ScrollSequence` runs `import('./sequence-player')`: 2.17 KB gz.
  - Both load after the window `load` event, in `requestIdleCallback` (Safari falls back to `setTimeout`).
- **T3, phase 2.** The 45–60 s film in a `<dialog>`, loaded on open.

**Why phones download 0 KB of motion JS.** The dynamic imports are plain `import()` calls inside `useEffect` of client components. The server never renders them, so Next emits no preload/modulepreload, and the effect returns before `import()` when the gate fails.

`next/dynamic` is not used for motion: it loads during hydration and cannot gate on media queries. Proven on the fixture: the touch profile fetched 3 scripts, and the body scan found none of `lenis-smooth`, `lk-cur__dot`, `createImageBitmap`, `restDelta` or `framerAppearId`.

**Gates (`src/motion/gates.ts`, no imports)**
- `richAllowed()`: `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`, `(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`, not `html.mode-teks`, and `innerHeight ≤ 2000`. The last condition keeps WRS-style never-scrolling renderers from getting the film or Lenis.
- `filmAllowed()`: rich, `(min-width: 1024px)` and no `navigator.connection.saveData`.
- `canvasAllowed()` → `canvasEligible()`: rich pointer, wide, no RM, no Mode teks, no Save-Data, `deviceMemory ≥ 4` or unknown (Safari and Firefox count as capable; desktop Firefox gets the canvas), and viewport ≤ 2000px. There is no effectiveType gate.
- `onGateChange()` listens to the three media queries and the `lk:teks` event. Switching RM or Mode teks on, or narrowing the window, tears down Lenis, the cursor, films and the player live.

**LazyMotion / m policy**
- v2 ships no `motion.*` or `m.*` components. Everything pointer-driven is vanilla DOM plus `springValue` on motion's frame loop, inside the lazy chunk.
- Measured costs (esbuild, gzip -9): full `motion` 40.7 KB; `LazyMotion` + `m` + `domAnimation` 27.3 KB; `springValue` + `frame` 9.1 KB.
- If a future leaf needs layout animation, it uses `m.*` inside `<LazyMotion strict features={() => import('./dom-animation').then(r => r.default)}>`, in a leaf that is itself imported behind `richAllowed()`.
- Add to `eslint.config.mjs` for `src/app/(frontend)/**/(v2)/**` and `src/components/v2/**`:
```js
{ rules: { 'no-restricted-imports': ['error', { paths: [
  { name: 'framer-motion', importNames: ['motion', 'AnimatePresence', 'useScroll', 'useTransform', 'useSpring', 'useInView'], message: 'v2: CSS/T1 first; T2 lives in src/motion/rich (dynamic). React motion only as m + LazyMotion strict in a gated leaf.' },
  { name: 'lenis', message: 'Lenis is loaded only by src/motion/rich.' } ] }] } }
```

**framer-motion leaves Navbar.** `Navbar.tsx:6` imports `motion` and `AnimatePresence`, which puts 44 KB gz on every page today. The v2 header is a Server Component with these parts:
- links always in the SSR DOM;
- a `[popover]` mega-menu opened by `popovertarget`;
- a phone `<dialog id="menu" class="lk-menu">` placed after the header logo, opened by `<MenuButton target="menu">` (`commandfor`/`command="show-modal"`), with SiteObserver's click fallback where Invoker Commands are missing;
- transitions via `@starting-style` (motion.css §5).

The only client island is `HeaderLogo`: `useHtmlAttr('data-sky')` drives one `<LogoFull theme>`, never a CSS-hidden twin.

**One rAF.** Lenis runs with `autoRaf:false`, driven by `frame.update(lenisRaf, true)`. Springs (`follow2d`) integrate on the same loop and write in `frame.render`. The canvas player measures in `frame.read` and paints in `frame.render`. No other rAF exists; CSS scroll timelines run on the compositor.

**SiteObserver contract (T1, mount once per root layout, outside `<main>`)**
- `html.js` is set after the first scan. If the chunk is blocked, nothing is ever hidden.
- `[data-reveal=lift|fade|split|words|wipe|inst]` gets `data-in` once, with a rootMargin of −8% at the bottom. Elements already on screen at scan time get `data-in` before `.js` exists. `fade` is decorative only, never text. `split` indexes lines from `offsetTop`, reading everything before writing.
- `[data-steps]`: the `[data-step-item]` crossing the 58–60% band sets `data-step=k`, `data-on` on `[data-step-panel][data-k=k]`, and `aria-current="step"`.
- `[data-sky=light|dark]`: `html[data-sky]` is taken from the deepest intersecting element in the top 8% band, using a live set so nested bands hand back correctly.
- `html[data-nav]=top|pill|hide`: one passive scroll listener, a ±4px jitter guard and one attribute write per change.
- `#mode-teks` toggles `html.mode-teks`, writes `localStorage 'lk-teks'` and dispatches `lk:teks`.
- `button[commandfor]` gets a click fallback that runs `showModal()`/`close()` only where `commandForElement` is missing.

**CSS scroll timelines and fallbacks**
| Effect | Timeline | Firefox / Safari < 26 |
|---|---|---|
| Day dial sun | `scroll(root)` | Static strip |
| Horizon wipe | `view()` | 900 ms transition on T1 `data-in` |
| Noon parallax | named `view-timeline: --plx` | Flat |
| Coral glow | `view()` | Full opacity |
| Stack scale | named `view-timeline: --stack` | Sticky only |

**ViewTransition, verified in the repo.** Next 16.2.6 bundles React `19.3.0-canary-3f0b9e61-20260317`, and its stable build exports `ViewTransition` (`next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js:395`). React DOM calls `document.startViewTransition`. `experimental.viewTransition` is declared (`config-shared.d.ts:687`, zod schema) but nothing in next/dist reads it; set it to `true` anyway. `@types/react` 19.2.14 declares the component only in `react/canary`, hence `src/types/react-canary.d.ts`. Use `template.tsx` in each `(v2)` group with `enter`/`exit` set to `"lk-page"` and `default="none"`.

**Guards applied everywhere:** reduced motion, Save-Data (film, loop and canvas), `deviceMemory ≥ 4` or unknown (canvas), Mode teks, viewport > 2000px (rich layer and canvas), forced-colors (cursor, lamp, glow and stills hidden), and print.

sections.title: 2. Canvas sequence player spec (ScrollSequence)
sections.body_markdown:
**Starting points.** `scratchpad/cinematic-tech/ScrollSequence.tsx` and `sequence-core.ts`, and `motion-tech/sz/src`. The previous pass in this folder was reviewed and fixed. **Fixes applied** 1. The runway is `calc(4 × min(100svh, 900px))`: each `
  • ` has `min-height: var(--stage-h)` from 1024px up. The sticky stage is `var(--stage-h)`, centred with `top: max(0px, (100svh − --stage-h)/2)`. This replaces `h-[250lvh] md:h-[350lvh]` and the `h-lvh` stage; in a 12,140px render the runway cannot exceed 3,600px. 2. The `mobile` frame tier (540×960, 60 frames) and the `lite`/`effectiveType` gate are deleted. Phones never run the player. 3. The island no longer imports framer-motion `useScroll` (7.8 KB gz of hooks on phones). Progress is computed from rects in the lazy player: `(stageTop − runwayTop) / (runwayHeight − stageHeight)`. 4. Frames load only after window load, and only within one viewport (IntersectionObserver rootMargin 100%). The order is coarse to fine: step frames first (0, 40, 80, 119), then first/last, then bisection (64, 32, 96, 16 …). The frames the player currently wants jump the queue; there are 4 fetch lanes at `priority: 'low'`. 5. Frames are decoded with `createImageBitmap` in a Blob Worker (WebKit blocks the main thread otherwise), 2 at a time, and transferred zero-copy. 6. The byte-budgeted window is `BITMAP_BUDGET = 128 MiB`, so `cacheCapacity = floor(budget / (w × h × 4))` = 36 frames at 1280×720. The window keeps the frames nearest the playhead, alternating ahead and behind, and reserves the 4 step frames. Eviction drops the farthest first. 7. Release offscreen: beyond one viewport every bitmap is `close()`d. The worker keeps the compressed blobs (≤2.5 MB), so returning is a decode, not a download. Mode teks and gate changes also close everything. 8. Scroll maps piecewise through the step frames (`frameAt`), so each step rests exactly on the frame that is also its static keyframe ``. That makes the canvas-to-img handover seamless and ensures the stop frames are HTTP-cache hits. 9. The canvas uses `alpha:false`, a cover crop with a focal point, and DPR ≤ 2 capped at the source pixel density. It stays at opacity 0 until the first paint (`data-drawn`). 10. The LOOP tier from final.md is restored: `

sections.title: 3. Defects found and deliberate deviations
sections.body_markdown:
**Defects fixed (inputs or the prior pass)**
1. **Design-system house lights.** `.house-lights > .hl-night { position: sticky; top: 0 }` has no height guard. When the band is taller than the viewport (landscape phones, or 360×640 with the bottom bar), its bottom, which holds the WhatsApp button and the anti-scam line, is covered before it is ever seen. motion.css §18 un-sticks it below 640px of height and in Mode teks; the design-system owner should adopt the guard.
2. **The tall-viewport metric in final.md.** It uses `scrollHeight`, which floors at the viewport, so a page shorter than 12,140/1.5 = 8,093px fails the ≤1.5 ratio falsely. The harness uses body content height.
3. **ScrollSequence island.** The cinematic-tech version imported framer-motion `useScroll`, adding 7.8 KB gz of hooks to phones. Removed (§2).
4. **Contract mismatch.** The prior motion files used a different contract from the design-system blueprint (`--aspal` vs `--c-aspal`, `html.teks` vs `.mode-teks`, `data-sky=putih|kertas|senja|malam` vs `light|dark`, `data-key` vs `data-stage`, and hard-coded z-index). They are aligned now:
   - The cursor reads the computed `--cursor-dot`/`--sky`.
   - The lamp uses `--lamp`.
   - Stacking uses the `--z-*` tokens.
   - Layout uses `--stage-h`/`--nav-h`/`--dial-h`.
   - Duplicated day dial, horizon, FAQ, `.btn:active` and Mode teks base rules were removed in favour of the design system's.
5. **Nested `data-sky` bands.** The sky observer only handled `isIntersecting` entries, so after an inner band left the header band, the outer section never re-fired. It now keeps a live set and picks the deepest element.
6. **Text hidden at rest.** Citation chips and prompt rows used `opacity: 0` on text; they now use mask transforms and a `::before` light. The ticker clipped lines 4–6 permanently on phones and under RM; all lines now show there.
7. **`background-color` transitions** on the header pill, the cursor dot and table rows broke the "nothing animates background-color" rule. The swaps are now instant, and the header condenses with `clip-path`.
8. **Canvas math on every page.** `gates.ts` imported `canvasEligible` from `sequence-core`, which put 0.79 KB gz of canvas math on every page. The gate moved into `gates.ts`.
9. **Rich layer in tall renderers.** It had no tall-viewport guard, so the film could load in a 12,140px renderer. `richAllowed()` now requires `innerHeight ≤ 2000`.
10. **Menu opener.** With framer-motion gone there was no declarative opener for the `<dialog>` menu, and `@types/react` 19.2.14 has no `commandfor` typing. Added `MenuButton` plus the SiteObserver fallback.
11. **`springValue(0, …)`** inferred the literal type `0`, which fails tsc. Now `springValue<number>`.

**Deviations from final.md, with reasons**
- **Phone keyframe band.** It uses the same T1 `data-step` observer as desktop, not CSS view-timelines. That costs 0 extra bytes (SiteObserver ships anyway), works in Firefox and Safari < 26 (so no separate inline-keyframe fallback), and is one mechanism instead of two. No-JS shows keyframe 0 and all text.
- **Stacking-card scale scrub.** It is a CSS `view-timeline` (desktop media query), not a T2 `useTransform`: 0 KB and compositor-driven; Firefox gets sticky only.
- **'Tampilkan anotasi'.** It uses the `:checked ~` sibling combinator instead of `:has()`: same 0 KB, wider support.
- **Header state.** It is written from a passive scroll listener without rAF. Reading `scrollY` forces no layout, and the attribute is written only on change.
- **Crawler ticker on phones.** It shows all 6 lines statically, not 3. A permanently clipped line would be hidden text.
- **LOOP tier.** It lives in the rich layer's `films()` instead of a separate FilmLoop component (one video mechanism).

4. **v2 CSS entry:** `@import` the design-system `tokens.css`, then `motion.css`.
5. **Both `(v2)` layouts (id, en):**
   - render `<DayDial/>`, the v2 `SiteHeader` (Server Component), the `<dialog id="menu">`, `.bottom-bar`, `.wa-pill`, `<main data-sky=…>`, `<SiteObserver/>` and `<RichGate/>`;

sections.title: 5. Acceptance harness (commands)
sections.body_markdown:
All scripts use Playwright from the repo's `@playwright/test`. Set `VERCEL_BYPASS=<automation secret>` for protected previews; results go to `./acceptance-out/`.
```bash
B=https://<preview>.vercel.app
BASE=$B node scripts/acceptance/perf-mobile.cjs / /layanan/jasa-seo-profesional /layanan/local-seo   # RUNS=3 median
BASE=$B H1_JSON=scripts/acceptance/h1.json node scripts/acceptance/states.cjs / /layanan/jasa-seo-profesional
BASE=$B node scripts/acceptance/tall-viewport.cjs / /layanan/jasa-seo-profesional /layanan/local-seo
BASE=$B node scripts/acceptance/motion-gate.cjs / /layanan/jasa-seo-profesional
node src/motion/sequence-core.check.ts
pnpm next build --experimental-analyze        # Turbopack analyzer UI (human review)
ANALYZE=true pnpm next build --webpack        # the installed @next/bundle-analyzer only works with webpack
```

**`perf-mobile.cjs`**
- Profile: 412×915, DPR 2.625, Android UA, 4× CPU, 1.6 Mbps down / 0.75 up, 150 ms RTT, no input, 6 s settle.
- Fails on: LCP > 2000 ms; H1 LCP more than 150 ms after FCP; TBT > 200; CLS > 0.05; initial JS > 170 KB (home) or > 150 KB (service); fonts > 100,472 B; any motion marker downloaded on the phone.

**`states.cjs`**
- Runs no-JS at 390 and 1440, reduced motion at 390 and 1440, and Mode teks at 1440. Takes full-page screenshots.
- Requires exactly one H1, equal to the approved string.
- Sweeps the whole page one viewport at a time and requires 0 hidden text.
- Fails on any inline `opacity:0` in the SSR HTML.
- Requires every JSON-LD string of 20+ characters to be visible text.
- Fails if the rich layer, Lenis or the player loads under RM or Mode teks, or if any img/video/canvas is painted in Mode teks.

**`tall-viewport.cjs`**
- Runs 412×732, 412×12140 and 1440×12140.
- Requires 0 hidden text, no horizontal overflow, and a content-height ratio ≤ 1.5.
- In tall renders: no .webm, at most the 4 keyframes from `/seq/`, and no rich chunk.

**`motion-gate.cjs`** (the enforced bundle gate: it scans every byte the device actually downloads)
- On the phone, after scrolling the whole page: no `lenis-smooth`, `lk-cur__dot`, `createImageBitmap`, `restDelta` or `framerAppearId`.
- On the desktop: the initial scripts are clean; after load the rich chunk (with Lenis) arrives, `html.rich` and `html.lenis` are set, and the player loads and draws when the page has a canvas.

**Markers.** The marker strings were verified to survive `esbuild -minify` for framer-motion 12.38 and Lenis 1.3.23.

**Real devices** (by hand, per final.md): a Redmi or Galaxy A on 4G, an iPhone on iOS 26/27, desktop Firefox (canvas and static CSS paths), a Windows wheel for Lenis, the Safari 60 fps cap, anchors under the nav, back/forward restoration, and the Local SEO Maps iframe (`data-cursor="hide"`, Lenis lets iframes through).

asset-production.summary:
I've written the asset production book for 'Sehari Semalam'. It covers every asset (about 55 rows), full production prompts and briefs, a 16-step pipeline with exact commands, the bake-off plan, the schedule and the blockers. The final scripts are in scratchpad/blueprint/asset-production/. Nothing in the repo was touched and no credits were spent.

Built and checked today:
- **Scripts:** optimize-images.mjs, grade.mjs (the Logink LUT as two .cube files), plates.mjs, check-manifest.mjs, render-html-frames.cjs, frames.sh, render-og.mjs and encode-webm.sh. All self-tests pass except encode-webm.sh, which is syntax-checked only because ffmpeg isn't installed. The frame renderer and frames.sh were run end to end, and a rendered pixel matched the predicted blend exactly.
- **Relight check:** plates.mjs automates the direction's '≤2px silhouette' rule. On full-size 2560×1440 images it takes 1.4 s, passes shifts of 0 and 2 px and fails a 4 px shift.
- **OG images:** 47 draft JPEGs, 16.7–46 KB each: 30 static pages including the optional AI pair, plus 7 blog posts and 10 categories from the live CMS. og-default.jpg is also rendered, and logo-light.svg is exported unchanged from Logo.tsx. Copying these into public/ fixes both live 404s now.
- **Also:** a 5.2 KB noise tile, prompts.json and a 45-entry asset-manifest.json.

**Defects in the binding direction (fixed in this book, need your approval):**
1. **Canvas budget can't be met.** On the real pipeline a photographic frame costs 46–66 KB, not the 28 KB assumed. 120 frames come to about 7.9 MB, and even the direction's lowest fallback is about 4.4 MB against the 2.5 MB cap. Fix: 25 frames with a short blend between neighbouring frames when drawing. That measured 1.66 MB. The canvas player code needs a small change for it.
2. **A 07.00 day plate can't show noon or dusk.** Its morning shadows are baked in. Fix: add a 12.40 and an 18.05 relight, each under the same ≤2px check.
3. **Veo and Kling don't take 21:9.** They generate 16:9 (or 9:16). Fix: generate the film still at 16:9 and crop the 21:9 band when encoding.
4. **Phone keyframes are the wrong shape.** 600×800 doesn't fit a full-width band capped at 360px. Fix: 800×720 (40 KB measured). Tablets reuse desktop frames, so no extra files.
5. **P1 composition:** the minaret and the kedai can't both fit one phone crop. Fix: minaret just right of centre, kedai at 70–85% across.
6. **Second ribbon-coloured object:** orange water tanks (and classic red kerupuk lids) break the one-object rule. Fix: blue/grey tanks, glass jars with aluminium lids.
7. **Location conflict:** the film is set in Jakarta Timur but is meant to be the same street as the Tebet (Jakarta Selatan) kedai. Fix: set both in Tebet.
8. **Copy:** 15.10 and 16.30 datelines should read 'SORE', not 'SIANG'. The OG drafts use SORE; please confirm.
9. **Low-memory video tier:** I recommend cutting it (about 1 MB), because the phone keyframe path already covers it. frames.sh can still build it if you keep it.
10. **Prototype naming bugs:** frame files were named 0000 instead of f0001, and the hover preview was 4:3 instead of 4:5. Fixed in the final scripts.

**Blocked:**
- **Figma Weave isn't linked.** Checked today: it replied 'You haven't linked your Figma account to Weave yet'. This blocks the bake-off and every generated still, plate and video.
- **ffmpeg isn't installed.** The copy bundled with Playwright can't encode VP9 and can't read Veo's MP4. This blocks the film encode, its posters and the encode-test step. Stills, frames and OG images are not blocked.
- **Case data defects** block the case covers and the 6 case-study OG images.
- **Minor:** macOS has no `timeout` command; use `perl -e 'alarm N; exec @ARGV' …` or install coreutils.

**Your to-do list (about 1.5 h):**
1. Link Weave at https://app.weavy.ai/settings?section=profile (sign in, Profile, link your Figma account).
2. In Weave, confirm commercial rights for image and video outputs and enough credits for about 245 image runs and 14 video clips. Each run is quoted and needs your approval.
3. In Terminal: `brew install ffmpeg coreutils exiftool`, then check that `ffmpeg -hide_banner -encoders` lists libvpx-vp9, libsvtav1 and libwebp.
4. Approve defect fixes 1–9 and decisions #2, #10 and #11.
5. Open Claude Design for the rooftop scene (P3), the OG template and the instrument briefs.
6. Book two hours for device QA on an iPhone, a Mac with Safari and a mid-range Android.
7. Fix and approve the case data.

**Schedule:** about 10–12 working days on the asset track once Weave and ffmpeg are unblocked (day 0), in line with the direction's 2–3 weeks. The live-HTML instruments run in parallel on the build track (about 9–10 days), starting with the two the pilot needs.

One side note: the live CMS query `/api/posts?where[status][equals]=published` returns HTTP 500, so the OG renderer filters by status itself. Worth a look by the build team.

(2) four city plates with the sky cut out (PNG alpha), crossfading the same way: day 0 -> noon .333 -> dusk .667 -> night 1; the night plate reaches full opacity by --p .95. (3) window-light layer, mix-blend-mode: screen, opacity 0 until --p .62 then 1 by .9. (4) haze: a linear-gradient screen layer from the horizon line (y about 240px) downward to 45% of the height, rgba(255,255,255,.35) at the horizon to 0, opacity peaking at 1 around --p .333 and 0 by .15 and .5. (5) traffic streaks: an SVG path traced over the toll road; after --p .7 draw 6-8 short blurred dash groups with stroke-dashoffset = f(--p): warm white headlights in the far lane moving left to right, red tail-lights in the near lane moving right to left (left-hand traffic), stroke 2-3px, filter blur 1px. No text, no UI, no logos anywhere. All images decoded before the first frame. Deliver the HTML plus its image folder; frames are rendered at --n=25 (8 per segment; stage keyframes land on frames 1, 9, 17, 25) with --dsf=2.

pipeline_steps: 0 · Unblock (owner): link Figma to Weave at https://app.weavy.ai/settings?section=profile; confirm commercial rights + credits; run `brew install ffmpeg coreutils exiftool` and check `ffmpeg -hide_banner -encoders | grep -E 'libvpx-vp9|libsvtav1|libwebp'` lists all three. Wrap long commands as `gtimeout 120 <cmd>` (or `perl -e 'alarm 120; exec @ARGV' <cmd>`; macOS has no `timeout`).

1 · Install the scripts in the repo (build team): copy scratchpad/blueprint/asset-production/{optimize-images.mjs,grade.mjs,plates.mjs,render-html-frames.cjs,frames.sh,encode-webm.sh,render-og.mjs,og-template.html,og-pages.json,check-manifest.mjs,logink-day.cube,logink-night.cube,fonts/} to scripts/assets/, and asset-manifest.json + prompts.json to docs/assets/. They resolve sharp 0.34.5 and @playwright/test from the repo's node_modules. Run the self-tests: `node scripts/assets/{optimize-images,grade,plates,check-manifest}.mjs --selftest`.

2 · Bake-off (D1): 6 prompts x 4 Weave models x 4 variants + Canva baseline, blind-renamed, scored on the rubric (section 9); video bake-off on the top two B3 stills (Veo vs Kling), each pushed through encode-webm.sh as the direction's dawn encode test.

3 · Generate (Weave MCP): weave_find_model('<model>') -> weave_upload_asset (references) -> weave_run_model (quoted, needs approval) -> weave_get_model_run_output. After the bake-off, publish a Weave tool 'Logink · Satu kota, satu hari' (style block + anchor refs + winning model + upscaler) and run it with weave_run_tool. Log every run in docs/assets/asset-manifest.json runs[]: exact prompt, model id/version, refs, seed, date, credits.
4 · Archive originals untouched (C2PA intact) in the private logink-assets-originals/<asset-id>/ folder before any edit; set 'original' in the manifest.

5 · QA (section 6): stills at 100% in four quadrants against the Indonesia checklist and gates; relights `node scripts/assets/plates.mjs drift atap-day.png atap-noon.png --limit=2` (exit 1 = regenerate); film for temporal stability, seam and banding.

6 · Attribution cleanup: every image is generated one aspect looser than its crop, and the crop removes the bottom band where corner badges sit (3:4->4:5 `--crop=0,0,6.25%,0`; 3:2->16:9 `--crop=0,0,15.625%,0`; 16:9->21:9 band in encode-webm.sh). Metadata is stripped on re-encode: sharp's default WebP/JPEG output drops EXIF/XMP/ICC and C2PA (asset-pipeline.md §2.3, metadata-strip-test.cjs: JPEG APP11 JUMBF 'c2pa' and PNG caBX both gone, WebP holds only the VP8 chunk); cwebp runs with -metadata none; ffmpeg with -map_metadata -1. Spot-check the first real file: `exiftool -a -G1 file.webp` (File/RIFF only) and contentcredentials.org/verify ('no Content Credentials').

7 · Grade once, after QA: `node scripts/assets/grade.mjs apply day raw/<id>.png --out=graded [--wb]` (night for 20.30/21.30; no --wb on dawn/dusk; the 18.05 sky gets no LUT). Video: the same .cube via encode-webm.sh LUT=logink-day.cube, so stills and film match. The still fed to Veo stays ungraded.

8 · Encode stills: `node scripts/assets/optimize-images.mjs graded/jam-0700-seo.png --out=src/assets/brand/jam --name=pendiri-brand-diskusi-cowork-kemang-pagi --crop=0,0,6.25%,0 --fit=1600x2000 --q=78 --minq=70 --budget=300` (exit 1 over budget). IG tiles: `--fit=480x480 --q=68 --budget=25 --pos=x,y`.

9 · Canvas: `node scripts/assets/plates.mjs sky-mask atap-day.png --out=work/sky-mask.png` -> manual cleanup -> `plates.mjs cutout <plate> work/sky-mask.png --out=work/<plate>-cut.png` x4 -> `plates.mjs windows atap-dusk.png atap-night.png --sky=work/sky-mask.png --out=work/atap-windows.png` -> Claude Design P3 scene -> `node scripts/assets/render-html-frames.cjs work/scene/index.html work/png --n=25 --dsf=2` -> `./scripts/assets/frames.sh work/png public/media atap-tebet` (<=2.5 MB, keyframes <=50 KB, else exit 1) -> `node scripts/assets/optimize-images.mjs work/atap-tebet-poster.png --out=src/assets/brand/atap --name=atap-ruko-tebet-pagi --q=78 --budget=300`.

10 · Film: `LUT=logink-day.cube OUT=work/film ./scripts/assets/encode-webm.sh buka-take3.mp4 buka` (xfade seam, VP9 2-pass <=1.5 MB, BT.709 posters) -> move work/film/buka-<sha8>/ to public/media/ and rename the posters to src/assets/brand/film/kedai-tebet-fajar-21x9.webp / -4x3.webp. If the sky bands: AV1=1 first, then NOISE=2; never raise the budget.

11 · OG: `node scripts/assets/render-og.mjs --out=public/og --cms=https://logink.co` (add --optional when the AI page ships and --cases after the case-data fix) -> public/og/*.jpg + public/og/index.json + public/images/og-default.jpg; copy logo-light.svg to public/images/. Wire buildMetadata ogImage to `${SITE.url}/og/${lang}-${key}.jpg`.

12 · Naming/hashing: static imports under src/assets/brand/** get Next's content hash (/_next/static/media/<name>.<hash>.webp, immutable). frames.sh and encode-webm.sh name public/media folders <asset>-<sha8> from a sha256 of the served bytes. OG files keep stable URLs (/og/<lang>-<page>.jpg).

13 · Storage: add a next.config headers() rule making /media/:path* 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable'. Then `curl -sI -r 0-1 https://<preview>/media/buka-<sha8>/buka-1920x820.vp9.webm` must return 206 with content-range; if it doesn't, move the WebM to Blob with asset-pipeline/upload-brand-assets.mjs. Payload Media (editorial only): mimeTypes ['image/*','video/webm'], resizeOptions 2560, formatOptions webp q80, og size JPEG, clientUploads: true. Then `pnpm payload migrate:create media_webm` must produce an empty migration.

14 · Manifest gate: fill files, sha8, captions, alt and qa{by,date} for each asset, then add CI `node scripts/assets/check-manifest.mjs docs/assets/asset-manifest.json`. It fails on unlisted files under src/assets/brand, public/media, public/og or public/images, and on shipped AI assets missing their exact prompt, model, date, captions or QA sign-off.

15 · Disclosure: a Figure component renders caption_id/caption_en from the manifest under every photo, film and canvas; mocks carry 'Ilustrasi · data contoh' + data-nosnippet; the footer line 'Ilustrasi dibuat dengan bantuan AI; klien, testimoni, tim dan hasil adalah nyata.'

16 · Acceptance on the preview: perf-mobile.cjs (LCP <=2.0 s, TBT <=200 ms, CLS <=0.05; no motion/Lenis/cursor/canvas code on coarse pointers); Safari macOS + iOS 17.4+ loop seam and poster swap; WhatsApp preview of / and one /layanan/* page; real Android on 4G; blocked-chunk / no-JS / reduced-motion runs.

sections.title: 1 · Defects found in the binding direction (fixes applied in this book; owner to approve)
sections.body_markdown:
1. **The canvas byte budget can't be met with the committed ladder.** I ran the exact pipeline (render-html-frames.cjs at 2x → frames.sh/cwebp) on a crossfade between a real 2560×1440 city photo and its night-graded copy. Results: **66 KB/frame** at 1280×720 q64, 62 KB at q60, and 46 KB at 1120×630 q60 (sharp on two photos: 59–80 KB). The direction's 28 KB/frame came from a soft flower clip. That puts 120 frames at ≈7.9 MB, and even the ladder's bottom rung (96 frames @1120 q60) at ≈4.4 MB, against the 2.5 MB cap.
   - **Fix:** 25 frames, 8 per segment, with stage keys on frames 1/9/17/25, at 1280×720 q64. Measured **1.66 MB**. The player blends the two nearest frames at runtime (build-team patch in `ScrollSequence.paint()`: draw floor(x), then ceil(x) at `globalAlpha = x − floor(x)`, and repaint on every progress change).
   - The composite is a crossfade of plates by design, so the blend loses only streak granularity, and blended streaks read as light trails anyway.
   - All 25 decoded bitmaps (92 MB RGBA) fit the 160 MB desktop cache.
   - Ladder: 37 frames if the real plates measure ≤65 KB/frame; otherwise 25, then q60, then 1120w.
2. **A single 07.00 day plate can't show noon or dusk.** Its long morning shadows are baked in, and a translating multiply layer can't remove them.
   - **Fix:** two more relight edits of P1 (P2a 12.40, P2b 18.05), under the same ≤2 px drift gate. The four plates crossfade and the shadow-sweep layer is dropped.
3. **Veo 3.x and Kling render 16:9 (or 9:16), not 21:9.** Confirm in `weave_find_model` params after linking. A 2560×1100 still would be letterboxed or cropped by the model.
   - **Fix:** generate P4a at 16:9 with all action in the central 12–88% band. encode-webm.sh crops the 21:9 band (1920×820), and the 4:3 phone poster comes from the same graded master.
4. **The 600×800 (3:4) phone keyframes don't fit the band.** The band is full width and ≤360 px tall (≈1.1:1 on 390–430 px phones), so a cover fit would throw away about a third of each keyframe.
   - **Fix:** 800×720 (10:9), measured 40 KB at q60. Tablets reuse desktop frames 1/9/17/25 through `<picture media>`, so no extra files.
5. **P1 puts the minaret mid-left and the kedai bottom-right.** No phone crop can hold both.
   - **Fix:** minaret at ≈52% x, kedai at 70–85% x. The crop box is `KEYCROP="960 0 1600 1440"` on the 2x render.
6. **Second ribbon-coloured object.** P1's 'orange and blue water tanks' break 'exactly one ribbon-coloured object' (orange is ribbon stop 4). Classic kerupuk tins with red lids repeat the trap in the film.
   - **Fix:** blue and grey tanks; clear glass jars with plain aluminium lids.
7. **Location conflict.** The film is in 'Jakarta Timur' but is 'the same street as the canvas's kedai' in Tebet, Jakarta Selatan.
   - **Fix:** both in Tebet. The film caption becomes 'Foto/film: ilustrasi AI · Jalan ruko, Tebet, Jakarta Selatan, 05.30 WIB · bukan klien Logink'.
8. **Copy.** The specimen reads '16.30 WIB — SIANG'. In Indonesian, roughly 15.00–18.00 is *sore*, so the OG drafts use 'SORE · DIPERCAYA' for 15.10 and 16.30. Owner to confirm.
9. **The LOOP tier is redundant.** Phones already get four keyframes crossfaded by CSS view-timelines, synced to the step text; the same path works on low-memory Chromium desktops. **I recommend cutting the 1 MB loop and its code path.** `LOOP=1 ./frames.sh` still builds it if the owner keeps it.
10. **Prototype mismatches (fixed in the final scripts).** frames.sh wrote `0000.webp`, but `sequence-core.frameUrl` expects `f0001.webp`. HoverRevealList's float is 320×240 (4:3) while the stills are 4:5; it must be 320×400.

Environment notes:
- macOS has no `timeout` (the harness rule): use `gtimeout` from coreutils or `perl -e 'alarm N; exec @ARGV'`.
- The live CMS query `/api/posts?where[status][equals]=published` returns **HTTP 500**, so render-og.mjs filters by status itself. Worth a look by the build team.

sections.title: 3 · Prompt blocks, Indonesia realism checklist and hour physics
sections.body_markdown:
Paste these blocks **verbatim** wherever a prompt says +STYLE, +INDONESIA, +PEOPLE or +EXCLUDE (also in prompts.json):

- **STYLE:** Editorial documentary photograph for an Indonesian newspaper weekend edition. 35mm lens, natural perspective, no wide-angle distortion. Kodak Portra 400 colour rendition, natural skin texture with visible pores and slight unevenness, everyday clothes with creases, real everyday clutter, weathered surfaces, no retouching, no beauty lighting, humid tropical air.
- **INDONESIA:** Indonesian realism: ruko shophouses with steel rolling shutters; terrazzo or plain ceramic floor tiles; terracotta roof tiles or corrugated sheets; a galon water dispenser; rattan or plastic chairs; round-pin C/F wall sockets; unbranded matic scooters, parked and driven on the LEFT side of the road (left-hand traffic); tangled overhead power lines; tropical plants (monstera, sansevieria, pucuk merah) in plastic pots.
- **PEOPLE:** People are anonymous: back turned, in profile or mid-action; faces small in frame or not visible; nobody looks at the camera or poses; hands are natural and busy with the task.
- **EXCLUDE:** No readable text or letters anywhere (signs, labels, packaging, screens, licence plates, clothing prints). No logos or brand marks. No watermarks. No visible screen content: phones, tablets and laptops face down, angled away or dark. No Gojek or Grab jackets or colours, no QRIS standees, no Monas or other landmarks, no right-hand traffic, no US-style sockets, no snow or autumn leaves, no ring light, no studio backdrop, no HDR look, no teal-and-orange grade, no oversaturated greens, no bokeh balls, no lens flare.

**Indonesia realism checklist (QA: any miss = reject or inpaint):**
1. Traffic keeps left; scooters are parked on the left kerb; steering wheels are on the right.
2. Sockets are round-pin C/F. Plates, signage, packaging and labels are blank or unreadable.
3. The architecture is ruko with rolling shutters, terrazzo or keramik floors, genteng or corrugated roofs, toren tanks, parabola dishes, jemuran and tangled power lines.
4. There is a galon dispenser, rice cooker, plastic or rattan chairs, or pots of tropical plants where plausible.
5. Batik is worn as office wear, not as costume. Women are a natural mix of hijab and non-hijab.
6. Ethnicity is named in every people prompt (Betawi, Javanese, Sundanese, Chinese-Indonesian, Batak, Minang), ages 20s–40s, with no generic influencer face.
7. Light and weather are humid haze or overcast as often as sun, with no snow or autumn.
8. There is exactly **one** ribbon-coloured object (coral awning, magenta notebook, crimson-magenta tote, coral sweep, coral card holder, orange tape; the 18.05 sky counts as the object).
9. Screens are never readable. UI is never composited into photos; the live-HTML instrument overlaps the photo's corner on a flat surface instead.
10. There are no Gojek/Grab greens, no QRIS marks, no landmarks, and no Western signage.

**AI tells to check at 100% in four quadrants:** finger count and joins, teeth, eye catchlights, plastic skin, duplicated faces or objects, merged chair legs, warped scooter wheels and spokes, laptop hinges, phone thickness, cables that start or end nowhere, shadow direction against the key light, HDR halos.

**Hour physics for Jakarta (≈6°S):** sunrise ≈05.45–06.05 WIB and sunset ≈17.45–18.15 WIB year-round.
- 05.30: civil twilight, street lamps on, no sun.
- 07.00: low sun from the east.
- 12.40: sun near zenith, short shadows under objects.
- 15.10 / 16.30: sun low in the west.
- 18.05: just after sunset, glow on the western horizon.
- 20.30 / 21.30: full night.

The rooftop camera faces **north**, so morning sun comes from frame right and the sunset glow sits low on the left.

sections.title: 4 · Storage, naming and repo changes (hand-off to the build team; the repo was read-only here)
sections.body_markdown:
**Where each asset lives:**
- **Static imports (hashed and immutable by Next, blurDataURL automatic):**
  - `src/assets/brand/jam/*.webp` (7 stills)
  - `src/assets/brand/film/kedai-tebet-fajar-{21x9,4x3,still}.webp`
  - `src/assets/brand/atap/atap-ruko-tebet-pagi.webp`
  - `src/assets/brand/instrumen/{ig-contoh-1..6,landing-kedai-contoh}.webp`
  - `src/assets/brand/tekstur/noise-128.webp`
- **Served as-is (worker fetch / `<video>`):**
  - `public/media/atap-tebet-<sha8>/{d1280/f0001–f0025.webp, key-m/k1–k4.webp}`
  - `public/media/buka-<sha8>/buka-1920x820.vp9.webm`
  - I chose public/ over Blob: one mechanism, deploys atomically with the code, ≈4 MB in git.
- **Stable URLs:** `public/og/*.jpg` + `public/og/index.json`, `public/images/og-default.jpg`, `public/images/logo-light.svg`.
- **Payload Media on Blob:** editorial only (blog covers, real client logos, case images, case-study VIDEO blocks as WebM, real team photos).

**next.config.ts:**
```ts
images: {
  formats: ['image/avif', 'image/webp'],            // decision #11 default: WebP masters, AVIF on the wire
  deviceSizes: [640, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536, 1920, 2560],
  imageSizes: [16, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 256, 384],
  qualities: [60, 75],                                // 60 = hover float
  remotePatterns: [{ protocol: 'https', hostname: 'rqtwb25xeycekd8y.public.blob.vercel-storage.com' }],
},
async headers() {
  return [{ source: '/media/:path*', headers: [{ key: 'Cache-Control', value: 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' }] }]
},
```
Verify with `curl -sI -r 0-1 https://<preview>/media/buka-<sha8>/buka-1920x820.vp9.webm`: expect 206 with content-range. If not, use `asset-pipeline/upload-brand-assets.mjs` to Blob.

**Payload (config only; the migration must be empty):**
```ts
// src/collections/Media.ts -> upload
mimeTypes: ['image/*', 'video/webm'],
resizeOptions: { width: 2560, withoutEnlargement: true },
formatOptions: { format: 'webp', options: { quality: 80 } },   // JPEG/PNG -> WebP, strips EXIF/GPS/C2PA
imageSizes: [ /* keep thumbnail, card, featured as-is (removing them changes columns) */
  { name: 'og', width: 1200, height: 630, position: 'centre', formatOptions: { format: 'jpeg', options: { quality: 80, mozjpeg: true } } } ],
// src/payload.config.ts
vercelBlobStorage({ clientUploads: true, collections: { media: { disablePayloadAccessControl: true } }, token: process.env.BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN || '' })
```
Then run `pnpm payload migrate:create media_webm` and confirm the migration is empty. SVG client logos are safe: `canResizeImage` (payload/dist/uploads/canResizeImage.js) excludes image/svg+xml, so they are never rasterised. Videos skip sharp. `clientUploads` is required because Vercel's 4.5 MB body limit rejects real WebM uploads otherwise.

**Component contracts:**
- ScrollSequence: adjacent-frame blend; runway `calc(4 × min(100svh, 900px))`; delete the mobile frame tier.
- Tablets use `<picture>` keyframes from d1280/f0001, f0009, f0017, f0025.
- HoverRevealList float must be 320×400.
- A `<Figure>` reads `caption_id/en` and `alt_id/en` from docs/assets/asset-manifest.json, so captions have one source.
- buildMetadata `ogImage`:
  - static pages: `/og/${lang}-${key}.jpg`
  - posts: `post.ogImage` (Payload og size), else `/og/${lang}-blog-${slug}.jpg` when listed in `/og/index.json`, else `/og/${lang}-blog.jpg`
  - cases: `/og/${lang}-portfolio.jpg` until the case OGs are unblocked

**Naming:** descriptive Indonesian kebab-case for static imports (Next appends the hash). `<asset>-<sha8>` folders in public/media, from a sha256 of the served bytes, written by frames.sh and encode-webm.sh. Frame files are `f0001.webp`… to match `sequence-core.frameUrl`. OG files are `<lang>-<page>.jpg`.

sections.title: 5 · QA gates by asset family
sections.body_markdown:
**Stills and plates:**
- Hard gates (any fail = reject):
  - readable text anywhere
  - a logo
  - right-hand traffic
  - wrong sockets
  - an anatomy error visible at 100%
  - a second ribbon-coloured object
  - a watermark outside the croppable band
- Then run the section 3 checklist.
- Relights must pass `plates.mjs drift … --limit=2`.
- After grading, check highlights for clipping (tropical windows) and shadows for plum overshoot at 200%.
- The 18.05 sky must read as a natural sunset running through the four ribbon hues.

**Film:**
- Temporal stability: jars, awning stripes, shutter slats and scooter wheels must not morph.
- The face never turns to camera.
- The lamp goes off at ≈5 s and the phone glows at ≈6 s.
- Push-in ≤3%.
- After encode:
  - loop the file 3× in Chrome and Safari (seam)
  - screenshot the poster vs video frame 1 (no visible shift; the BT.709 decode handles this)
  - check the dawn sky at 200% for banding. If it bands: `AV1=1`, then `NOISE=2`. Never raise the 1.5 MB budget.
- Any fail: ship the graded still with a CSS light sweep.

**Canvas:**
- `frames.sh` exits 0 (≤2.5 MB, keyframes ≤50 KB).
- Scrub at 1× and at flick speed on a Windows wheel and a Mac trackpad: blends show no double horizon or ghost buildings.
- Keyframes are legible at 390 px.
- The static tier shows the poster with its alt.

**OG:**
- ≤150 KB (render-og exits 1 otherwise).
- Send / and one /layanan/* link to yourself on WhatsApp; also check LinkedIn Post Inspector and opengraph.xyz.
- The logo sits only on Putih, Kertas, Senja or Malam.

**Metadata:**
- `exiftool -a -G1` on one of each type shows only File/RIFF/JFIF groups.
- contentcredentials.org/verify returns 'no Content Credentials' on the first real file.

**Manifest:** `check-manifest.mjs` passes in CI. Each asset has `qa.by` and `qa.date`, with the owner as approver for anything showing people.

sections.title: 8 · Disclosure and captions
sections.body_markdown:
- **Per asset:** the caption lives in asset-manifest.json (`caption_id`/`caption_en`) and renders as a newspaper caption line under the image. It never sits on the image.
  - Pattern: `Foto: ilustrasi AI · {tempat}, {HH.MM} WIB · bukan klien Logink` / `Photo: AI illustration · {place}, {HH.MM} WIB · not a Logink client`.
  - Film: `Foto/film: ilustrasi AI · Jalan ruko, Tebet, Jakarta Selatan, 05.30 WIB · bukan klien Logink`.
  - Canvas: `Foto: ilustrasi AI · Atap ruko Tebet, Jakarta Selatan, 07.00–21.30 WIB · bukan klien Logink`, placed in the flat step column.
- **Mocks:** 'Ilustrasi · data contoh' / 'Illustration · sample data', always with data-nosnippet.
- **Footer:** 'Ilustrasi dibuat dengan bantuan AI; klien, testimoni, tim dan hasil adalah nyata.' / 'Illustrations are made with AI assistance; clients, testimonials, team and results are real.'
- **Alt text** is descriptive Indonesian (EN on /en), from the manifest. Collage layers use alt='' except one.
- **Never generated:** clients, testimonials, team, offices shown as Logink's, portfolio work, results, real brand logos or UIs.
- **Provenance:** the manifest records the exact prompt, model id/version, refs, seed, date and credits for every run, plus the archived original with C2PA intact. That covers Anthropic's AUP, UU 8/1999 Pasal 17, and any future Komdigi labelling rule.

sections.title: 9 · Model bake-off plan
sections.body_markdown:
**Six image prompts (B1–B6), chosen to stress different failure modes:**
- B1 = P1 rooftop day plate: density, wires, sky separability, Indonesian roofs.
- B2 = P2c night relight of each model's own B1 winner: edit consistency, scored by `plates.mjs drift`. A model without an edit mode scores 0.
- B3 = P4a film still: dawn light, puddle reflections, a small anonymous person.
- B4 = P5 batik boutique: hands on a phone tripod, fabric, hard noon light.
- B5 = P12 night seller: tungsten/blue mix, hands taping, blank labels, low-light noise.
- B6 = P9 product shoot: glass, blank labels, coral hue accuracy.

**Models, via Weave (use the current versions `weave_find_model` lists):** Nano Banana Pro, FLUX (Pro tier; edits via FLUX Kontext Pro), Seedream, GPT Image. Each gets 4 variants at 2K from the identical text. Canva generate-image runs B1 + B4 × 4 as a baseline for the fallback.

**Counts:** 96 Weave images + 8 Canva.

**Video:** the top 2 B3 stills × {Veo 3.x, Kling} × 2 takes = **8 clips**. Each goes through `encode-webm.sh` at the real 1.5 MB budget; this doubles as the direction's 'encode-test a real dawn clip' gate.

**Blind scoring:**
```
mkdir blind && for f in raw/*; do h=$(shasum "$f" | cut -c1-8); cp "$f" "blind/$h.${f##*.}"; echo "$h,$f" >> blind-key.csv; done
```
Two raters (owner + Claude) score independently in bake-off.csv (hash, prompt, model, variant, gates, scores, weighted, rater, notes).

**Image rubric:**
- Hard gates (fail = out): readable text, logo, right-hand traffic, wrong sockets, visible anatomy error, second ribbon object, uncroppable watermark.
- Scores 1–5 with weights:
  - Realism & materials ×2
  - Indonesian authenticity ×2
  - Hour/light fidelity ×1.5
  - Composition & crop safety ×1
  - Gradeability (apply logink-day.cube: no clipping, no baked HDR/teal-orange) ×1
  - Brand discipline ×1
  - Series consistency across the 4 variants ×1.5
- Max 50.
- B2 adds drift: 0–1 px = 5, 2 px = 4, 3 px = 2, ≥4 px = fail.

**Video rubric:** temporal stability ×2, brief compliance (lamp, phone glow, left-hand traffic, push-in) ×1.5, anatomy ×1.5, seam ×1, banding/blocking at budget ×2.

**Decision rule:**
- Per series, pick the highest mean among gate-passing models; on a tie, the one with fewer credits.
- The plate set (P1 + P2a–d) must come from one model pair: the B1 and B2 winners, or the best combined score.
- Film: the best video model on B3.

**Effort:** ≈1 working day, including 1 h of owner scoring.

build-plan.summary:
Phased delivery plan for the 'Sehari Semalam' redesign of logink.co (repo /Users/mm/logink/logink_website/logink-website, production branch feat/payload-cms, deployed through the Vercel CLI).

Staffing is one senior engineer with Claude Code, with the owner producing assets and decisions in parallel. The core engineering effort for Phases 0–5 is 44–62 working days. The calendar is about 11–14 weeks, from Mon 28 Sep 2026 to mid-Dec 2026, because the pilot's 2–3-week soak runs alongside the Phase 3 build. The Phase 6 extras add 8–15 days in 2027 Q1.

**Phases**
- **Phase 0 (4–6 days)** ships fixes on today's site:
  - a codemod that removes `opacity: 0` from 184 framer `initial` props in 72 files
  - FAQ answers moved into `<details>`
  - counters and case metrics rendered with their final values
  - a correct SSR `<html lang>` through two root layouts
  - sitemap, llms.txt and head hreflang generated from a new `src/lib/services.ts` registry
  - `og-default.jpg` and `logo-light.svg` at the paths `seo.ts` already uses
  - 8 new permanent redirects and deletion of the 1,100-line legacy `[slug]` template
  - `useReportWebVitals` sending to the GTM dataLayer
  - case-data corrections
  - on day 1, copying the ephemeral scratchpad baseline and QA scripts into `scripts/qa/`
- **Phase 1 (7–10 days)** builds the foundation:
  - tokens and Archivo/Martian fonts (100,472 B, one preload)
  - chrome (header, menus, bottom bar, WhatsApp pill, closing band, footer)
  - motion leaves ported from the prototypes
  - a section library
  - four root-layout route groups: `(legacy)`, `(legacy-en)`, `(v2)`, `(v2-en)`
  - a `pnpm qa` gate suite
- **Phase 2 (6–8 days + 2–3 week soak)** pilots `/layanan/jasa-seo-profesional` and its EN twin with one revertable `git mv` swap commit.
- **Phase 3 (9–13 days)** rolls out the other 5 services, plus the optional `/layanan/jasa-seo-ai` pair.
- **Phase 4 (10–14 days)** builds home with the film, the rooftop canvas and the instruments.
- **Phase 5 (8–11 days)** covers hubs, about, portfolio, blog, contact, legal and the 404, then deletes all legacy code.
- **Phase 6** holds the full film, the AI visibility log and later city pages.

**Rollout rules**
- No database schema change is planned. The Media change is config-only and must show an empty `migrate:create`. Keeping the Media imageSizes (not dropping card/featured) keeps Instant Rollback safe.
- Legacy components for a page group are deleted only after that group's soak.
- Every ship goes through a preview, then a staged production deployment (`vercel --prod --skip-domain`), then `pnpm qa`, then `vercel promote`.

**Defects found in the chosen direction** (details in the first section)
- The Lead Profiler's server-side lead save conflicts with the required email and message on contact-submissions.
- The pilot's ranking comparison has almost no statistical power, because the site has about 0 organic clicks.
- The baseline and scripts live only in /private/tmp.
- `scripts/` is gitignored.
- lang and the route-group swap together require four root layouts.
- A layout cannot build the switcher from the server pair map, because layouts get no pathname.
- Dropping Media imageSizes would break rollback.
- The popover menu is not supported on the Safari 16.4 that browserslist still targets.
- There is no CI.
- Previews share the production Neon database.

sections.title: Defects found in the chosen direction (everything else treated as binding)
sections.body_markdown:
The plan keeps final.md's hard rules, palette, type, SSR contract, T0–T3 tiers, budgets and owner defaults. The items below are real defects or gaps found while planning the build, each with the resolution the plan uses.

1. **The Lead Profiler cannot save leads server-side (home §04) on today's schema.** `src/collections/ContactSubmissions.ts` requires `name`, `email` and `message` (lines 18–25), and `/api/contact` zod requires an email and a message of at least 10 characters. The profiler collects no email.
   - Default: no server save. Fire a dataLayer `lead_profiler_complete` event and use the per-path wa.me prefill.
   - If the owner wants DB capture: add an additive migration making email and message optional (dropping NOT NULL is safe for rollback) and set `source:'lead_profiler'`. About +0.5 day in P4.
2. **The pilot's 2–3-week comparison has almost no ranking signal.** seo-data shows 4 keywords at positions 49–94 and about 0 organic clicks.
   - The window is kept as a soak.
   - Its exit criteria are indexing and render, RUM CWV, the WhatsApp `cta_click` rate, and the impressions trend against the 5 legacy service pages as a control.
3. **The research sources are ephemeral.** The baseline CSV, crawl, render and perf scripts, prototypes and specimen live in `/private/tmp/...scratchpad`. They are copied into the repo on P0 day 1.
4. **`scripts/` is gitignored** (.gitignore line 43), so `ui-review.mjs` has never been versioned. It also hardcodes `BASE='https://logink.co'` and waits for `networkidle`, which will stall once film, canvas and GTM run. Fixes:
   - un-ignore the folder
   - read BASE from the environment
   - use `load` plus 1.5 s instead of networkidle
   - add `/layanan/local-seo`, every `/en/*` page and the bypass header
5. **The lang fix and the route-group swap interact.** `<html lang>` lives in the root layout, so the (legacy)→(v2) swap needs **four root layouts** (group × locale). Consequences:
   - moving between legacy and v2 pages is a full reload, so `<ViewTransition>` works only v2↔v2
   - the two Tailwind builds must be isolated with `@config`
6. **A layout cannot build the switcher from the server pair map**, because layouts receive no pathname. That is exactly how `usePathname` produced `/index`. v2 chrome is rendered by `PageShell` inside each page, with an `alternate` prop from the registry or `slugEn`.
7. **Dropping Media imageSizes would break rollback.** asset-pipeline §4.2 suggests dropping `card` and `featured`, which drops columns and breaks Instant Rollback. All four sizes are kept, so the Media change stays config-only with an empty migration.
8. **No framer-motion upgrade.** motion-tech suggests framer-motion 13.4.4. final.md says v12, and the prototypes type-check against the installed 12.38. The plan stays on 12.38 and bumps only if cursor INP measures above 200 ms.
9. **Popover support gap.** The popover mega-menu and `@starting-style` need Safari 17 or 17.5, but `browserslist` still lists Safari 16.4. An `@supports not selector(:popover-open)` fallback covers it.
10. **There is no CI.** Vercel's GitHub integration is off and deploys go out from a local checkout. In this plan, 'CI gates' means `pnpm qa` against the staged deployment, run before `vercel promote`, plus an optional secret-free GitHub Action.
11. **Previews write to production data.** They share the production Neon database, so write tests (contact E2E) run locally against a Neon branch.
12. **Static pages have no source for a real lastmod** (the sitemap uses request time today). The fix is a per-page `updatedAt` in the registry, which is also the value shown as 'Diperbarui'.

sections.title: Route-group architecture and the swap mechanics
sections.body_markdown:
```
src/app/
  (payload)/…                  untouched, own root layout
  sitemap.xml/route.ts         registry-driven, revalidate 3600
  llms.txt/route.ts            P0, registry-driven
  global-not-found.tsx         P5 (experimental.globalNotFound)
  (frontend)/
    root-shell.tsx             P0 shared html/body/GTM/WebVitals
    (legacy)/layout.tsx        root, lang=id, imports ../../globals.css  (was (public)/layout.tsx)
    (legacy)/…                 current ID pages
    (legacy-en)/layout.tsx     root, lang=en                             (was en/layout.tsx)
    (legacy-en)/en/…           current EN pages
    (v2)/layout.tsx            root, lang=id, styles/fonts.ts + styles/site.css, RevealObserver, RichLayer
    (v2)/v2-kit/page.tsx       noindex; notFound() in production
    (v2-en)/layout.tsx         root, lang=en
    (v2-en)/en/…
```

- **P0 keeps the folder names.** `(public)/layout.tsx` and `en/layout.tsx` become root layouts. Next 16 docs (layout.md line 142): 'Any layout without a layout.js above it is a root layout.' The rename to `(legacy)` and `(legacy-en)` is one URL-neutral `git mv` in P1, proven by a crawl diff with zero changes.
- **Swapping one page group** is a single commit:
```
mkdir -p 'src/app/(frontend)/(v2)/layanan' 'src/app/(frontend)/(v2-en)/en/services'
git mv 'src/app/(frontend)/(legacy)/layanan/jasa-seo-profesional' 'src/app/(frontend)/(v2)/layanan/'
git mv 'src/app/(frontend)/(legacy-en)/en/services/seo-content-marketing' 'src/app/(frontend)/(v2-en)/en/services/'
# keep generateMetadata; body → <ServicePage k="seo" locale="id" alternate="/en/services/seo-content-marketing" />
git commit -m 'swap(seo): legacy → v2'
```
- **Group rollback** is `git revert <swap sha>` followed by a deploy.
  - Legacy components for a group are deleted only in a later commit, at least 14 clean days after its ship. Until then, revert always works.
  - Next refuses to build if two groups resolve the same URL, which is a free guard against a half-done swap.
- **Swap order:**
  1. P2: seo pair
  2. P3: localseo, social, creative, website, ads, plus the AI pair as new URLs
  3. P4: `/` and `/en`
  4. P5: layanan hub, about, portfolio (+[slug]), blog (+[slug], category), contact, privacy, terms
  5. Then delete `(legacy)` and `(legacy-en)`.
- **CSS isolation:**
  - `src/styles/site.css` starts with `@config "../../tailwind.v2.config.ts";`.
  - The v2 content globs are `./src/components/v2/**/*.{ts,tsx}` plus the escaped `./src/app/\\(frontend\\)/\\(v2*\\)/**/*.tsx`.
  - Legacy `tailwind.config.ts` content narrows to `src/components/{public,ui}/**` and the legacy groups.
  - A gate keeps inlined CSS per page at or below 82 KB (`experimental.inlineCss` stays on).
- **Day-1 check in P1:** `next build` with the kit page and one dummy `(v2-en)/en/services/zz-test/page.tsx` proves that URL prefixes can span groups. Delete the dummy afterwards.

sections.title: Registry contract and the v2 file tree
sections.body_markdown:
```ts
// src/lib/services.ts  (P0; the only place a service URL, name, price or H1 is written)
export type Stage = 'ditemukan' | 'dipercaya' | 'dikutip' | 'dihubungi'
export type Service = {
  key: 'seo' | 'localseo' | 'social' | 'creative' | 'website' | 'ads' | 'ai'
  cmsSlug: string | null            // 'seo-content-marketing' … (null for ai)
  idPath: string; enPath: string    // '/layanan/jasa-seo-profesional' ↔ '/en/services/seo-content-marketing'
  nameId: string; nameEn: string
  group: 'organik' | 'penjualan' | 'kreasi'   // live mega-menu goal groups
  stage: Stage; hour: string        // '07.00' | '08.30' | '12.40' | '15.10' | '16.30' | '18.05' | '20.30'
  light: 'paper-magenta' | 'paper-crimson' | 'senja' | 'malam'
  priceFrom: { id: string; en: string; billing?: 'tahunan' }
  tiers?: { name: string; price: number; unit: 'bulan' | 'proyek'; popular?: boolean }[]
  h1: { id: string; en: string }    // approved strings; content.mjs asserts h1.textContent === h1[locale]
  wa: { id: string; en: string }    // per-page prefill (attribution)
  updatedAt: string                 // ISO; renders 'Diperbarui', feeds sitemap lastmod
  live: boolean                     // ai=false → hrefOf('ai') returns '/layanan/jasa-seo-profesional#ai-search'
}
export const SERVICES: Service[]
export const PAIRS: readonly [idPath: string, enPath: string, updatedAt: string][]  // static pages + live services
export const hrefOf = (key: Service['key'], locale: 'id' | 'en') => string
export const waLink = (text = '') => `https://wa.me/${SITE.whatsapp}?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`
```

**Consumers:**
- legacy Navbar, Footer, ServicesSection and LanguageSwitcher (P0)
- sitemap.xml and llms.txt routes
- buildMetadata alternates
- seo.ts graph() Offer
- v2 MegaMenu, Footer, CrossSell, LoopPosition, ServicesTable and PriceTable
- content.mjs, for the H1 and price assertions

One test (`node --test scripts/qa/registry.test.mjs`) checks:
- every path is unique
- each pair is bidirectional
- `live:false` entries never appear in PAIRS
- every `h1.id` starts with the service keyword

**v2 tree:**
- `src/styles/`: tokens.css, site.css, prose.css, fonts.ts
- `src/components/v2/chrome/`: PageShell, Header, NavState, MegaMenu, MobileMenu, DayDial, WaPill, BottomBar, LangSwitch, ClosingBand, HouseLights, Footer
- `src/components/v2/motion/`: RevealObserver, SplitText, guards, RichLayer, Cursor, Magnetic, HoverRevealList, StackingCards, motion-tokens
- `src/components/v2/sections/`: Section, Dateline, TitleCard, KataLebar, Stabilo, SourceChip, Ilustrasi, FactsDl, PriceTable, CompareTable, FaqDetails, Steps, ProcessStack, CrossSell, Breadcrumbs, Sources, Byline, Media, Button, HorizonBand
- `src/components/v2/instruments/`: SerpMaps, ReportFrame, InstagramReview, WebsiteFrame, AdToChat, AiAnswer, QueryFanout, PromptTable, ShareOfVoice, CrawlerLog, JsonLdFragment, PhoneScreens, ProofLoupe, ModeTeks
- `src/components/v2/service/`: ServicePage, ServiceHero, JawabanSingkat, LoopPosition, WorkSteps, AiReady, builders/SocialBuilder, builders/CreativeBuilder
- `src/components/v2/home/`: Hero, FactStrip, ServicesTable, LeadProfiler, Overture, ChapterPagi, ChapterSiang, ChapterSenja, ChapterMalam, Subuh
- `src/components/v2/cinematic/`: FilmLoop, ScrollSequence, sequence-core (+check)
- `src/components/v2/case-study/` (P5)
- `src/content/`: services/*.ts, home.ts, about.ts, lead-profiler.ts

**Surfaces** are the only way to set colour.
- `<Section surface="kertas">` renders `class="s-kertas" data-surface="kertas"`, which sets `--bg --ink --ink-2 --accent --accent-lg --link --rule --focus`.
- Components use only those semantic variables, so a banned pair (coral text on paper, magenta on Malam) cannot be expressed. aa.mjs lints for raw hex and ribbon-colour classes to enforce it.

sections.title: Gate suite: scripts, thresholds, commands
sections.body_markdown:
Run the gate against any deployment:
```
BASE=https://<deployment>.vercel.app VERCEL_BYPASS=<secret> pnpm qa   # → scripts/qa/gate.sh
```

`gate.sh` runs these in order and fails fast:
1. `tsc --noEmit`
2. `pnpm lint`
3. `node scripts/qa/aa.mjs`
4. `node scripts/qa/content.mjs`
5. `node scripts/qa/render.cjs`
6. `node scripts/qa/perf.cjs`
7. `python3 scripts/qa/crawl.py crawl $BASE scripts/qa/out/new.csv`
8. `python3 scripts/qa/crawl.py diff scripts/qa/baseline/baseline_2026-09-26.csv scripts/qa/out/new.csv --allow scripts/qa/h1-changes.csv`
9. `node scripts/qa/ui-review.mjs`
10. `pnpm exec playwright test scripts/qa/visual.spec.ts`

Each script has its own timeout, and the Playwright scripts never wait for networkidle.

| Script | Checks | Threshold |
|---|---|---|
| crawl.py diff | status, canonical, title, desc, H1, robots, sitemap loc set; html_lang, head hreflang, jsonld_types, words_visible, opacity0_inline, zero_stats, bad_switcher_links, internal_links | The first group must be equal (changes allowed only via h1-changes.csv). html_lang must match the URL prefix. hreflang is id/en/x-default with no duplicates. JSON-LD types are a superset of before. Words are ≥85% of old, and service pages have 900–1,300. opacity0 on text is 0 and zero_stats is 0. Every internal href is 200 with no chains. Redirects are single-hop. |
| content.mjs | SSR HTML with scripts stripped, per URL in manifest.json | Exactly one H1, equal to the registry string. Prices and FAQ answer openings are present. Every JSON-LD string ≥20 characters is visible. The denylist `\[Klien\]|Duomark|Halllo|Lorem|TODO|>0(\.0)?\s*[×%+]<` finds nothing. Inline script is ≤60 KB. Every mock has the Ilustrasi label and data-nosnippet. No 'Selengkapnya' or 'Learn more' anchor. Each service has ≥3 SSR inlinks. |
| render.cjs | no-JS 412×732, JS 412×732 and JS 412×12140 (Googlebot UA); 390 touch; reduced motion; dynamic chunks blocked | 0 hidden text elements. docH ratio ≤1.5. Every text node's (colour, nearest data-surface) pair is in the allowed matrix, including at 0/25/50/75/100% of each pinned runway. No text over img, video or canvas. No horizontal overflow. 0 requests for lenis, cursor or sequence chunks on touch. Reduced-motion content equals the no-JS content. |
| aa.mjs | tokens.css × surfaces, computed with the cr.mjs formula; lint over src/components/v2 | 100% of allowed pairs pass: ≥4.5 for text, ≥3 for large-only (Crimson/Kertas 4.53, Coral/Senja Dalam 4.06) and non-text (Garis UI 3.22). 0 raw hex or ribbon-colour text classes. |
| perf.cjs | 412×915 DPR 2.625, 4× CPU, 1.6 Mbps, 150 ms RTT, median of 3 | LCP ≤2.0 s target and fail >2.5 s. LCP−FCP <300 ms. TBT ≤200 ms. No task over 150 ms after hydration. CLS ≤0.05. Initial JS ≤170 KB (services) or ≤200 KB (home) transferred. ≤1 MB before interaction. |
| visual.spec.ts | @playwright/test toHaveScreenshot | LogoFull on Putih, Kertas, Senja and Malam: 0 px diff. Kit page at 1440, 768 and 390. |
| ui-review.mjs | full-page screenshots of every sitemap URL at 1440/768/390 | Human review against spec-1440.jpg and spec-390.jpg and the previous run. |

**Real devices** are required from P2 onward:
- Redmi or Galaxy A on 4G
- iPhone on iOS 26/27
- desktop Firefox
- Windows with a wheel mouse

`ANALYZE=true pnpm build` confirms that framer-motion, lenis and the cursor code are not in the initial chunks of v2 routes.

sections.title: Git, previews, promotion and rollback runbook
sections.body_markdown:
1. **Branching:**
   - `git fetch && git switch main && git merge --ff-only origin/feat/payload-cms && git push` puts main back in line with production (owner OK).
   - Phase 0 work goes on `git switch -c fix/phase0 origin/feat/payload-cms`, then merges back with `--ff-only`.
   - The redesign lives on `git switch -c redesign/v2 feat/payload-cms`, which merges `feat/payload-cms` in weekly so content hot-fixes flow through.
   - Each shippable slice (P1 scaffold, P2 pilot, P3 services, P4 home, P5 rest) merges back into `feat/payload-cms`.
2. **Preview:** run `vercel` (no `--prod`) from the branch. Previews get `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` automatically. Never attach a custom domain to a preview; if a `staging.` domain is ever added, add a noindex header in vercel.json scoped to that host. Automation uses the Protection Bypass header.
3. **Staged production:**
   1. `vercel --prod --skip-domain` builds with production env vars without taking traffic.
   2. Run `BASE=<staged url> pnpm qa`.
   3. `vercel promote <staged url>`.
   4. Verify on https://logink.co: no X-Robots-Tag noindex, robots meta 'index, follow', og:image 200, the WhatsApp CTA works.
   5. Append the date, sha, deployment URL and swapped groups to `scripts/qa/ship-log.csv`.
   `scripts/deploy-prod.sh` wraps these steps and refuses a dirty tree or the wrong branch.
4. **Baseline crawl:** `scripts/qa/baseline/baseline_2026-09-26.csv` (40 paths: 35 sitemap URLs plus /index, /en/index, /layanan/seo-content-marketing, /services and /blog/category/seo) is the frozen 'before'.
   - Re-crawl production the day before each ship (`crawl.py crawl https://logink.co scripts/qa/baseline/pre-<phase>_<date>.csv`) to catch CMS drift.
   - Diff the staged deployment against both files.
   - The sitemap-driven URL list also covers the posts the old sitemap omitted.
5. **Launch hygiene:**
   - Ship Monday or Tuesday.
   - Check the Google Search Status Dashboard for a running core update.
   - Freeze CMS edits during launch week.
   - Ship one page group per deployment, so the 'previous deployment' is always a clean rollback target (Hobby plans can only roll back one step).
6. **Rollback triggers** (from seo-safe-immersive §8):

| Severity | Trigger | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Hard (same day) | Any baseline URL non-200 when it should be 200; noindex or a wrong canonical in production; H1 or main copy missing from SSR; >1% 5xx; WhatsApp CTA broken; a contact form 4xx/5xx | `vercel rollback` (or promote the previous deployment), then `git revert <swap sha>` and fix forward |
| Soft (review weekly) | Organic clicks to a page group down >20% for 2 consecutive weeks with impressions also down; top-20 non-brand average position worse by >3; RUM LCP p75 >3.0 s or INP p75 >300 ms for 7 days; WhatsApp cta_click rate down >25% | Diagnose per template, then revert only that group's swap commit (legacy code is still present until its soak ends) |

Database: none of the rollbacks need database work, because no schema changes ship.

sections.title: Search Console, RUM and AI-answer monitoring
sections.body_markdown:
- **Before the pilot** (needs GSC access):
  - Add or verify `sc-domain:logink.co`.
  - Submit `https://logink.co/sitemap.xml`.
  - Record 28-day baselines per page group: home, the 6 service pairs, case studies and blog.
  - RUM `web_vitals` from Phase 0 gives 2–4 weeks of field baseline by pilot day.
- **Day 0 of every ship:**
  - URL Inspection → Test live URL and request indexing for each swapped URL. Check the rendered screenshot shows the H1, the manifest strings appear in the rendered HTML, the Google-selected canonical is self, and no page resources are blocked.
  - Add a GA4 annotation.
- **Days 1–14 daily, then weekly to week 6:**
  - GSC Pages: 'Crawled/Discovered – currently not indexed', 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical', 404s.
  - GSC Performance by page group (clicks, impressions, position vs the 28 days before, same weekdays).
  - GSC Crawl stats: response time should fall.
  - GSC CWV report (it lags about 28 days).
  - RUM p75 LCP, INP and CLS by template from the `web_vitals` events.
  - GA4 organic sessions and WhatsApp `cta_click` rate per landing page.
- **Tooling in this environment:** once access exists, the GSC_GA4 MCP tools (`gsc_compare_periods`, `gsc_top_pages`, `gsc_inspect_url`, `gsc_index_coverage`, `ga4_landing_pages`) make this a 10-minute weekly check. Ahrefs `site-explorer-ai-responses-count` tracks the AI-citation baseline (1 today).
- **Weekly AI spot-check:** 'jasa SEO Jakarta', 'agensi digital marketing 360 Jakarta' and brand queries in ChatGPT search, Perplexity and Google AI Mode.
  - Is Logink cited?
  - Are the quoted numbers the real ones (never '0 %')?
  - Log the results; they feed the quarterly AI visibility log (P6).
- **Pilot exit review** (end of week 2 or 3): run the criteria in Phase 2, then make the go/no-go decision for shipping Phase 3.
